objetivo: Rescue the other club members across the Mushroom Kingdom as Monika.
descripcion_corta: A creative crossover hack of Super Mario Bros. featuring Monika from DDLC.
descripcion_larga: This modification replaces Mario's sprites and palettes with Monika's aesthetic. The gameplay remains the classic platformer experience but with a unique visual twist for fans of the visual novel.

objetivo: Navigate the classic Super Mario levels using Natsuki's character sprites.
descripcion_corta: A visual character-swap hack featuring Natsuki in the original Super Mario Bros.
descripcion_larga: Natsuki enters the 8-bit world of Mario in this hack. It features customized colors and character art, bringing the world of Doki Doki Literature Club to a retro platforming setting.

objetivo: Complete the original Mario adventure playing as the cheerful Sayori.
descripcion_corta: A fun visual modification that puts Sayori into the classic NES Mario game.
descripcion_larga: Sayori takes center stage in this character-swap hack. While the level design is the original SMB1, the visual assets are updated to reflect Sayori's personality and character design.

objetivo: Traverse the Mushroom Kingdom as Yuri to save the literature club.
descripcion_corta: A character-swap hack featuring Yuri from DDLC in a classic 8-bit adventure.
descripcion_larga: This version features Yuri as the main protagonist. The hack focuses on visual consistency, using Yuri's color palette and sprites to replace the traditional Mario assets.

objetivo: Navigate an amusement park and use your soccer ball to defeat enemies and save your girlfriend.
descripcion_corta: A colorful and fun action game set in a dangerous amusement park.
descripcion_larga: Known in the West as The Trolls in Crazyland, this original version stars a young boy. The gameplay revolves around using a ball as a projectile and managing a unique health system that changes as you take damage.

nombre: Doki! Doki! Yuuenchi (Japan) [En by No Talent v1.1] (~Doki! Doki! Amusement Park)
objetivo: Navigate an amusement park and use your soccer ball to defeat enemies and save your girlfriend.
descripcion_corta: The English translation of the vibrant Famicom platformer Doki! Doki! Yuuenchi.
descripcion_larga: This fan translation allows players to enjoy the story and mechanics of this hidden Famicom gem, which features impressive graphics and creative level designs based on theme park attractions.

objetivo: Unify the northern provinces of Japan during the Sengoku period.
descripcion_corta: A deep historical strategy game focused on the life of Date Masamune.
descripcion_larga: Developed by Namco, this title blends tactical army management with RPG elements. Players must manage resources, negotiate with rivals, and win large-scale 8-bit battles to build their empire.

objetivo: Use your hammer to turn enemies into projectiles and clear each stage.
descripcion_corta: A charming and fast-paced arcade port featuring two dwarf carpenters.
descripcion_larga: Very similar in feel to Bubble Bobble, Don Doko Don features Bob and Jim. They must stun enemies with their hammers and throw them into others to clear the screen and reach the boss of each world.

objetivo: Journey through a fantasy kingdom to save the King and Queen.
descripcion_corta: A beautiful and refined platforming sequel with larger, scrolling levels.
descripcion_larga: Unlike the first game, the sequel features scrolling stages and more complex platforming. It is highly praised for its high-quality 8-bit graphics, boss fights, and polished gameplay mechanics.

objetivo: Explore various levels to rescue Huey, Dewey, and Louie.
descripcion_corta: The Japanese Famicom version of the Disney classic "Snoopy's Silly Sports Spectacular" (Visual swap).
descripcion_larga: In Japan, this game used the Donald Duck license. It features various mini-games and platforming sections where players must navigate obstacles in a bright Disney-themed world.

objetivo: Rescue Ronald McDonald's friends from the evil Gumon using explosive apples.
descripcion_corta: A McDonald's-themed adventure featuring Ronald and his colorful world.
descripcion_larga: Players control Ronald McDonald (Donald in Japan) through several levels based on McDonaldland. The primary mechanic involves throwing bombs to clear enemies and overcome environmental hazards.

objetivo: Climb the construction site to rescue Pauline from the giant ape.
descripcion_corta: A faithful port of the legendary arcade game that introduced Mario.
descripcion_larga: This early Famicom title captures the essence of the original masterpiece. Players must jump over barrels and climb ladders across iconic stages to reach the top and save the damsel in distress.

objetivo: Climb the construction site to rescue Pauline from the giant ape.
descripcion_corta: The definitive revised version of the classic Donkey Kong arcade port.
descripcion_larga: This revision ensures the most stable performance and accurate 8-bit recreation of the arcade original, featuring the classic three-stage loop that defined the platforming genre.

objetivo: Shoot bug spray at Donkey Kong to push him up while defending your garden.
descripcion_corta: A unique departure from the original series, featuring Stanley the Bugman.
descripcion_larga: Donkey Kong 3 shifts the action to a greenhouse. Players must spray DK to keep him at bay while avoiding swarms of bees and other insects in this fast-paced arcade shooter.

objetivo: Defend the garden and push DK to the top with improved visuals.
descripcion_corta: A celebratory modern hack of DK3 featuring updated palettes and fixes.
descripcion_larga: This 40th Anniversary edition refreshes the classic gameplay with vibrant colors and technical adjustments to celebrate four decades of Nintendo's arcade legacy.

objetivo: Navigate difficult levels to rescue the captured Kong family.
descripcion_corta: A notorious unlicensed "demake" or pirate sequel of the DK series.
descripcion_larga: Often found on multi-carts, this pirate title attempts to create a new adventure using assets from various NES games, offering a curious and challenging unofficial sequel.

objetivo: Climb the girders and rescue Pauline with modernized 8-bit visuals.
descripcion_corta: An anniversary tribute hack of the original DK with restored colors.
descripcion_larga: This version provides a more arcade-accurate experience on the NES, updating the graphics and colors to celebrate the 40th anniversary of the game's release.

objetivo: Master the levels of both Donkey Kong and Donkey Kong Jr.
descripcion_corta: A two-in-one cartridge featuring Nintendo's most iconic early arcade hits.
descripcion_larga: Donkey Kong Classics brings together the two foundational games of the franchise, allowing players to experience the rise of Mario and the rescue of DK in one package.

objetivo: Journey through the island to recover the banana hoard.
descripcion_corta: An impressive unlicensed NES "demake" of the SNES classic DKC.
descripcion_larga: This bootleg attempts to replicate the pre-rendered look and feel of the Super Nintendo game on 8-bit hardware, featuring Donkey and Diddy Kong in original levels.

objetivo: Complete a refined version of the unlicensed DKC NES port.
descripcion_corta: An optimized and improved version of the unlicensed Donkey Kong Country.
descripcion_larga: This version (v1.5) fixes many of the glitches and physics issues found in the original bootleg, making it a much more playable and impressive 8-bit tribute.

objetivo: Use vines and chains to reach the key and rescue your father.
descripcion_corta: A classic sequel where players control Junior to save Donkey Kong from Mario.
descripcion_larga: In a rare twist, Mario is the antagonist. Players must climb through jungle-themed levels, dropping fruit on enemies to reach the cage at the top of the screen.

objetivo: Use vines and chains to reach the key and rescue your father.
descripcion_corta: The definitive revised version of the classic arcade port of DK Jr.
descripcion_larga: This revision offers the most accurate 8-bit reproduction of the arcade sequel, featuring the iconic four-stage loop and polished climbing mechanics.

objetivo: Solve math problems and complete platforming stages.
descripcion_corta: A rare Japanese bundle combining the classic game with a math lesson.
descripcion_larga: This "Jr. Lesson" edition was designed to be educational, using the DK Jr. mechanics to help children learn basic arithmetic through 8-bit gameplay.

objetivo: Rescue Donkey Kong with updated graphics and smoother animations.
descripcion_corta: A modern anniversary hack that enhances the visual fidelity of DK Jr.
descripcion_larga: Celebrating 40 years of the character, this hack updates the color palette to more closely match the arcade cabinet, providing a fresh look for the NES port.

objetivo: Solve math equations by collecting numbers and symbols on vines.
descripcion_corta: A unique educational title that uses DK Jr. mechanics to teach math.
descripcion_larga: Part of Nintendo's "Education Series," this game challenges players to reach a target number by climbing and collecting digits, either solo or in a competitive mode.

nombre: Donkey Kong Jr. no Sansuu Asobi (Japan)
objetivo: Solve math equations by collecting numbers and symbols on vines.
descripcion_corta: The original Japanese Famicom version of Donkey Kong Jr. Math.
descripcion_larga: This version features the same educational gameplay as the Western release, focusing on addition, subtraction, and multiplication within the jungle setting.

objetivo: Navigate through a fantasy world as the dinosaur Dooly to save the land.
descripcion_corta: A South Korean action game based on the popular "Dooly the Little Dinosaur."
descripcion_larga: This title features the iconic cartoon character in a vibrant world, using various powers to defeat enemies and overcome platforming challenges.

objetivo: Lure enemies into doors and shut them to clear the stage.
descripcion_corta: An early Enix-developed puzzle game with simple but addictive mechanics.
descripcion_larga: Players control Chun, who must strategically open and close doors to trap various types of creatures, requiring careful timing and planning across many levels.

objetivo: Travel through time with Doraemon to stop Giga Zombie's evil plans.
descripcion_corta: A deep and high-quality RPG based on the iconic Doraemon franchise.
descripcion_larga: This RPG features Doraemon and his friends exploring different historical eras. It includes a party system, turn-based combat, and many of Doraemon's famous gadgets.

nombre: Doraemon - Giga Zombie no Gyakushuu (Japan) [En by WakdHacks v1.0] (~Doraemon - The Revenge of Giga Zombie)
objetivo: Travel through time with Doraemon to stop Giga Zombie's evil plans.
descripcion_corta: The English translation of the epic RPG "The Revenge of Giga Zombie."
descripcion_larga: This fan translation allows players to enjoy the full story and dialogue of one of the best licensed RPGs on the Famicom, making the gadgets and combat clear.

objetivo: Complete various tasks and levels as the robotic cat Doraemon.
descripcion_corta: A Chinese-localized or unlicensed Doraemon title featuring various mini-games.
descripcion_larga: This version often includes modified assets and simplified gameplay, aimed at fans of the series in the Chinese-speaking market.

objetivo: Clear different stages based on the movies to find Doraemon's friends.
descripcion_corta: A diverse and challenging game that switches between shooting and action.
descripcion_larga: Developed by Hudson Soft, this title features three distinct worlds: a shooter, a top-down adventure, and an underwater level, each with unique mechanics.

objetivo: Clear different stages based on the movies to find Doraemon's friends.
descripcion_corta: An English-translated version of the Hudson Soft Doraemon classic.
descripcion_larga: This hack translates the text and fixes mapper issues, allowing players to navigate the difficult multi-genre stages of this 8-bit classic in English.

objetivo: Clear different stages based on the movies to find Doraemon's friends.
descripcion_corta: A revised version of the classic Hudson Soft Famicom title.
descripcion_larga: This revision includes minor technical fixes to ensure the game runs smoothly across all Famicom hardware revisions while maintaining its high difficulty.

objetivo: Answer trivia questions and complete physical challenges to win.
descripcion_corta: An 8-bit adaptation of the popular Nickelodeon game show.
descripcion_larga: Just like the TV show, players must compete in messy "physical challenges" and obstacle courses, using quick reflexes and trivia knowledge to beat the clock.

objetivo: Fight through gangs to rescue Marian from the Black Warriors.
descripcion_corta: The legendary brawler that defined the genre on the NES.
descripcion_larga: Unlike the arcade, the NES version features an XP system to unlock moves. Players control Billy Lee in a gritty urban setting filled with iconic 8-bit enemies.

objetivo: Fight through gangs to rescue Marian from the Black Warriors.
descripcion_corta: The original Famicom release of the foundational urban brawler.
descripcion_larga: Known for its challenging platforming and intense combat, this version introduced the leveling system that would make the NES port a cult classic in its own right.

objetivo: Fight through gangs to rescue Marian from the Black Warriors.
descripcion_corta: An early prototype of Double Dragon with minor gameplay differences.
descripcion_larga: This beta offers a look at the game's development, featuring variations in enemy behavior, sound, or level layouts compared to the final retail release.

objetivo: Fight through gangs to rescue Marian from the Black Warriors.
descripcion_corta: The legendary brawler that defined the genre on the NES.
descripcion_larga: Players must master punches, kicks, and environmental weapons. The NES version is famous for its unique level design and the final showdown for the title of Dragon.

nombre: Double Dragon (USA) [Hack by Hiro1112 v1.1] (Arcade Mix)
objetivo: Rescue Marian in a version of the game that mimics the arcade's colors.
descripcion_corta: A visual hack designed to make the NES port look more like the arcade original.
descripcion_larga: This "Arcade Mix" updates the color palettes and sprites to provide a more visually faithful experience to the 1987 arcade cabinet while keeping the NES mechanics.

objetivo: Avenge Marian's death by defeating the mysterious Shadow Warrior leader.
descripcion_corta: Widely considered the best entry in the NES trilogy, featuring 2-player co-op.
descripcion_larga: This sequel introduces the "directional attack" system and iconic special moves like the Cyclone Kick. Players battle through nine stages of gritty urban and industrial landscapes.

objetivo: Avenge Marian's death by defeating the mysterious Shadow Warrior leader.
descripcion_corta: The original Famicom release of the legendary beat 'em up sequel.
descripcion_larga: Known as "The Revenge," this version features cinematic cutscenes between levels that tell a tragic story of loss and vengeance, setting a high bar for 8-bit storytelling.

objetivo: Avenge Marian's death by defeating the mysterious Shadow Warrior leader.
descripcion_corta: An early prototype of the sequel with potential differences in sound and balance.
descripcion_larga: This beta version offers a technical look at the development of Double Dragon II, featuring the same core combat but with minor variations from the final retail release.

objetivo: Avenge Marian's death by defeating the mysterious Shadow Warrior leader.
descripcion_corta: The definitive 8-bit co-op brawler featuring intense combat and platforming.
descripcion_larga: As Billy and Jimmy Lee, players must master the timing of jumps and special attacks to survive the trap-filled hideout of the Shadow Warriors.

nombre: Double Dragon II - The Revenge (USA) (Rev A)
objetivo: Avenge Marian's death by defeating the mysterious Shadow Warrior leader.
descripcion_corta: A revised version of the US release with minor technical improvements.
descripcion_larga: This revision ensures the best performance on NES hardware, maintaining the tight controls and memorable soundtrack that made the sequel a massive success.

nombre: Double Dragon III - The Rosetta Stone (Japan)
gameplay: Side-scrolling beat 'em up with RPG elements.
objetivo: Travel the world to find the Rosetta Stones and stop an ancient evil.
descripcion_corta: The challenging third entry featuring swappable characters and a shop system.
descripcion_larga: Known as "The Rosetta Stone," this version features a unique shop mechanic and allows players to recruit defeated bosses like Chin and Ranzou to their team.

nombre: Double Dragon III - The Sacred Stones (Europe)
gameplay: Side-scrolling beat 'em up with RPG elements.
objetivo: Travel the world to find the Rosetta Stones and stop an ancient evil.
descripcion_corta: An international quest for justice featuring legendary martial arts combat.
descripcion_larga: The third installment takes the Lee brothers to the USA, China, Japan, Italy, and Egypt. It is known for its high difficulty and technical character-switching mechanics.

nombre: Double Dragon III - The Sacred Stones (USA)
gameplay: Side-scrolling beat 'em up with RPG elements.
objetivo: Travel the world to find the Rosetta Stones and stop an ancient evil.
descripcion_corta: The final chapter of the original NES trilogy, focusing on global exploration.
descripcion_larga: In the "Sacred Stones," players must manage their limited lives across multiple world locations, using team-up attacks and specialized weapons to survive.

nombre: Double Dragon III - The Sacred Stones (USA) [Hack by Jedi QuestMaster v1.0] (Difficulty Fix)
objetivo: Travel the world and defeat enemies with a more balanced difficulty curve.
descripcion_corta: A gameplay hack that adjusts the infamously high difficulty of the third game.
descripcion_larga: This version modifies enemy health and damage output, making the game more accessible and enjoyable for players who found the original release too punishing.

objetivo: Outscore the opposing team across four quarters of intense basketball.
descripcion_corta: A classic Konami sports title famous for its "cinematic" slam dunk shots.
descripcion_larga: Double Dribble was a pioneer in 8-bit sports, featuring digitized speech and close-up animations for dunks that brought an arcade feel to the home console.

objetivo: Outscore the opposing team across four quarters of intense basketball.
descripcion_corta: A classic Konami sports title famous for its "cinematic" slam dunk shots.
descripcion_larga: Double Dribble was a pioneer in 8-bit sports, featuring digitized speech and close-up animations for dunks that brought an arcade feel to the home console.

objetivo: Outscore the opposing team across four quarters of intense basketball.
descripcion_corta: A revised version of the popular 8-bit basketball simulation.
descripcion_larga: This revision includes minor bug fixes to ensure smooth performance during the fast-paced gameplay and iconic cinematic dunk sequences.

objetivo: Journey through a fantasy world to save the kingdom from ancient monsters.
descripcion_corta: A late-era Famicom RPG with high-quality graphics and a deep storyline.
descripcion_larga: Legend of the Double Moon features a traditional party system and turn-based combat, set in a beautifully rendered world that showcases the limits of 8-bit RPG design.

objetivo: Pilot a combat jet to eliminate terrorist threats and destroy enemy bases.
descripcion_corta: An intense unlicensed flight shooter with a military theme.
descripcion_larga: Published by American Video Entertainment, this game challenges players to navigate hazardous airspaces while managing fuel and ammunition across multiple missions.

objetivo: Pilot a combat jet to eliminate terrorist threats and destroy enemy bases.
descripcion_corta: A revised version of the unlicensed shooter with improved performance.
descripcion_larga: Version 1.1 of Double Strike offers the same high-octane aerial combat as the original, with technical refinements to the game's scrolling and hit detection.

objetivo: Infiltrate enemy lines and plant explosives to destroy the base.
descripcion_corta: A unique war-themed puzzle game where you play as a demolition expert.
descripcion_larga: As Dough Boy, players must carefully navigate mines, trenches, and enemy fire to deliver a bomb to the target, requiring a mix of stealth and quick thinking.

nombre: Downtown - Nekketsu Koushin Kyoku - Soreyuke Daiundoukai (Japan)
objetivo: Compete in a chaotic city-wide athletic tournament with no rules.
descripcion_corta: The legendary Kunio-kun sports game featuring cross-country and fighting.
descripcion_larga: Players choose a school team and compete in races that involve jumping over buildings and fighting rivals in the streets, blending athletics with 8-bit brawling.

nombre: Downtown - Nekketsu Koushin Kyoku - Soreyuke Daiundoukai (Japan) [En by Disconnected v0.15] (Technos Cross-Country) (Incomplete)
objetivo: Compete in a chaotic city-wide athletic tournament with no rules.
descripcion_corta: An English fan translation of the classic Kunio-kun athletic brawler.
descripcion_larga: This version makes the team stats and menus of the chaotic tournament accessible, allowing players to fully enjoy the over-the-top violence of the school competitions.

objetivo: Rescue Ricki's girlfriend and defeat the rival gangs of River City.
descripcion_corta: The original Japanese version of the cult classic "River City Ransom."
descripcion_larga: This game revolutionized the genre by adding RPG elements, allowing players to buy food and books to upgrade their stats while fighting through non-linear urban stages.

nombre: Downtown Special - Kunio-kun no Jidaigeki Dayo Zenin Shuugou! (Japan)
objetivo: Travel across ancient Japan to unite the provinces and defeat rivals.
descripcion_corta: An ambitious Kunio-kun spin-off set in the historical Edo period.
descripcion_larga: Known as "Jidaigeki," this title features a massive world to explore, companion recruitment, and deep stat customization, all set in a humorous 8-bit version of samurai history.

nombre: Downtown Special - Kunio-kun no Jidaigeki Dayo Zenin Shuugou! (Japan) [En by TSamurai v1.0] (Technos Samurai)
objetivo: Journey through ancient Japan to restore peace and defeat rival clans.
descripcion_corta: The English translation of the historical Kunio-kun adventure, Jidaigeki.
descripcion_larga: This fan translation makes the deep RPG systems and historical dialogue of the Kunio-kun samurai spin-off accessible, featuring stat building and world exploration in 8-bit Edo Japan.

objetivo: Explore a haunted mansion to find your brother and defeat interdimensional monsters.
descripcion_corta: A unique hybrid of action platforming and point-and-click adventure.
descripcion_larga: Dr. Chaos challenges players to explore a massive house, switching from side-scrolling hallways to first-person room searches to find items and warp zones in this sci-fi horror title.

objetivo: Match medical icons or items to clear the screen and score points.
descripcion_corta: A creative visual hack of Dr. Mario featuring the famous cat, Garfield.
descripcion_larga: This modification replaces the classic Dr. Mario assets with Garfield-themed graphics, offering the same addictive puzzle gameplay with a fresh aesthetic for fans of the lasagna-loving cat.

objetivo: Reach the church for your wedding while managing your stress level.
descripcion_corta: A notoriously difficult and surreal game based on the classic gothic novella.
descripcion_larga: Players must navigate a hostile town as Jekyll. If the stress meter fills, they transform into Hyde in a dark dream world. The game is famous for its high difficulty and unique dual-character mechanic.

objetivo: Guide Dracula through the town to reach his girlfriend while avoiding angry mobs.
descripcion_corta: An unreleased NES prototype featuring a humorous take on the vampire legend.
descripcion_larga: Originally planned as a Reebok-sponsored title, this game features Dracula using magic and stealth to navigate levels, offering a rare look at a canceled 8-bit project.

objetivo: Defeat King Piccolo and his minions to save the world.
descripcion_corta: The first card-battle RPG in the Dragon Ball Famicom series.
descripcion_larga: Using a board game movement system and cards for combat, this title covers the King Piccolo saga, blending strategic decision-making with iconic 8-bit anime cutscenes.

nombre: Dragon Ball - Le Secret du Dragon (France)
objetivo: Collect the seven Dragon Balls and defeat the Rabbit Gang and Emperor Pilaf.
descripcion_corta: The French version of the first Dragon Ball game, based on the early series.
descripcion_larga: This action game features Goku using his Power Pole. It is known for its high difficulty and for being one of the few official Dragon Ball releases in the West during the 8-bit era.

nombre: Dragon Ball - Le Secret du Dragon (France) (Rev A)
objetivo: Collect the seven Dragon Balls and defeat the Rabbit Gang and Emperor Pilaf.
descripcion_corta: A revised French version of the first Dragon Ball action game.
descripcion_larga: This revision includes minor technical fixes to ensure better performance on European NES consoles while maintaining the classic Goku adventure gameplay.

nombre: Dragon Ball - Shen Long no Nazo (Japan)
objetivo: Collect the seven Dragon Balls and defeat the Rabbit Gang and Emperor Pilaf.
descripcion_corta: The original Japanese version of Goku's first Famicom adventure.
descripcion_larga: Featuring the early Dragon Ball story, this game combines top-down combat with side-scrolling boss fights, setting the stage for the franchise's massive success on Nintendo hardware.

nombre: Dragon Ball - Shen Long no Nazo (Japan) (Mapper 34 Hack) [En by TransBRC v1.11] (~Dragon Ball - Dragon Mystery)
objetivo: Collect the seven Dragon Balls and defeat the Rabbit Gang and Emperor Pilaf.
descripcion_corta: The English translation of Goku's first Famicom action game.
descripcion_larga: This fan translation brings the original "Shen Long no Nazo" to English speakers, restoring the story and dialogue that were heavily altered in the US version (Dragon Power).

objetivo: Relive Goku's journey from the start of the series to the fight with Piccolo Junior.
descripcion_corta: A comprehensive RPG covering the majority of the original Dragon Ball story.
descripcion_larga: This title refined the card-battle system and featured impressive 8-bit cinematic battles, allowing players to grow Goku from a child to a powerful young man.

nombre: Dragon Ball Z - Kyoushuu! Saiya Jin (Japan)
objetivo: Defeat the invading Saiyans, Nappa and Vegeta, to protect Earth.
descripcion_corta: The first Dragon Ball Z game on Famicom, introducing the Raditz and Vegeta sagas.
descripcion_larga: This game moved the series into the "Z" era, featuring strategic card combat where the stars on the card determine attack and defense power in cinematic 8-bit battles.

nombre: Dragon Ball Z - Kyoushuu! Saiya Jin (Japan) [En by Twilight v1.01] (~Dragon Ball Z - Assault of the Saiyans)
objetivo: Defeat the invading Saiyans, Nappa and Vegeta, to protect Earth.
descripcion_corta: The English translation of the first DBZ card-battle RPG.
descripcion_larga: This version allows fans to experience the start of the Z saga in English, making the complex card mechanics and character stats fully understandable for the first time.

objetivo: Fight as various Z-warriors in a tournament-style combat game.
descripcion_corta: A notorious unlicensed fighting game featuring Dragon Ball Z characters.
descripcion_larga: Often found on multi-carts, this bootleg attempts to bring a Street Fighter-style experience to the NES using DBZ sprites, offering a fast-paced but unpolished fighting experience.

nombre: Dragon Ball Z Gaiden - Saiya Jin Zetsumetsu Keikaku (Japan)
objetivo: Stop the Hatchiyack and the Destron Gas from destroying Earth.
descripcion_corta: A unique DBZ game featuring an original story not found in the manga.
descripcion_larga: Known as "Plan to Eliminate the Saiyans," this game features high-quality 8-bit graphics and a complex card system where players combine symbols to perform special moves.

nombre: Dragon Ball Z Gaiden - Saiya Jin Zetsumetsu Keikaku (Japan) [En by Twilight v1.0] (~Dragon Ball Z Gaiden - Plan to Eliminate the Saiyans) (Vegeta Control)
objetivo: Stop the Hatchiyack and defeat the enemies with manual control over Vegeta.
descripcion_corta: An English-translated version of DBZ Gaiden with a gameplay modification.
descripcion_larga: This specific hack allows players to have more control over Vegeta's actions during the card battles, adding a new layer of strategy to this fan-translated original story.

nombre: Dragon Ball Z II - Gekishin Freeza!! (Japan) (Rev 1)
objetivo: Travel to Namek and defeat the tyrant Frieza and his Ginyu Force.
descripcion_corta: The epic sequel to the Saiyan saga, covering the Namek and Frieza arcs.
descripcion_larga: Considered one of the best in the series, it features a massive world map and intense cinematic battles as the Z-warriors race to find the Namekian Dragon Balls.

nombre: Dragon Ball Z II - Gekishin Freeza!! (Japan) (Rev 1) [En by Saiya v0.70] (~Dragon Ball Z II - Evil Freeza!) (Incomplete)
objetivo: Travel to Namek and defeat the tyrant Frieza and his Ginyu Force.
descripcion_corta: An English translation of the legendary Frieza saga RPG.
descripcion_larga: This version makes the deep strategy and iconic storyline of the Frieza arc accessible in English, though some versions are noted as incomplete in their translation.

nombre: Dragon Ball Z II - Gekishin Freeza!! (Japan) [En by Saiya v0.70] (~Dragon Ball Z II - Evil Freeza!) (Incomplete)
objetivo: Travel to Namek and defeat the tyrant Frieza and his Ginyu Force.
descripcion_corta: An English-translated version of the Namek saga card-battle RPG.
descripcion_larga: This entry ensures that players can follow the mission objectives and card systems while reliving the most famous arc in Dragon Ball Z history on the Famicom.

nombre: Dragon Ball Z III - Ressen Jinzou Ningen (Japan)
objetivo: Defeat the Androids and the bio-android Cell to save the future.
descripcion_corta: The third DBZ RPG, covering the Android and Cell sagas.
descripcion_larga: This title introduced more fluid combat animations and faster-paced gameplay, focusing on the high-stakes battles against Dr. Gero's creations and the ultimate lifeform, Cell.

nombre: Dragon Ball Z III - Ressen Jinzou Ningen (Japan) [En by Twilight v1.0] (~Dragon Ball Z III - Killer Androids)
objetivo: Defeat the Androids and the bio-android Cell to save the future.
descripcion_corta: The English translation of the Famicom's Android and Cell saga RPG.
descripcion_larga: This fan translation opens up the final main-series card-battle RPG on the Famicom, allowing fans to play through the Cell Games with full English text.

objetivo: Navigate a world map and explore dungeons to rescue a princess from a dragon.

objetivo: Fight through stages and transform into a powerful dragon to defeat bosses.

objetivo: Fight through stages and transform into a powerful dragon to defeat bosses.

objetivo: Rescue President Ronnie from a group of evil ninjas.
descripcion_corta: The Japanese Famicom version of the arcade hit "Bad Dudes."

objetivo: Collect crystal balls and defeat the master of the castle.

objetivo: Defeat the Dragonlord and recover the stolen Sphere of Light.
descripcion_corta: The game that defined the JRPG genre on home consoles.

nombre: Dragon Quest II - Akuryou no Kamigami (Japan)

descripcion_corta: A massive sequel that introduced the party-based combat system.
descripcion_larga: Expanding on the original, DQII features a much larger world, sea travel, and more complex dungeons, challenging players with some of the toughest balancing in the series.

nombre: Dragon Quest III - Soshite Densetsu e... (Japan) (Rev 0A)
objetivo: Defeat the archfiend Baramos and uncover your father's legacy.
descripcion_corta: A masterpiece of the 8-bit era featuring a deep class/job system.
descripcion_larga: DQIII allows players to create their own party members at the tavern. It features a day/night cycle and a dual-world twist that solidified its status as a legend in Japan.

nombre: Dragon Quest III - Soshite Densetsu e... (Japan) (Rev B)
objetivo: Defeat the archfiend Baramos and uncover your father's legacy.

nombre: Dragon Quest IV - Michibikareshi Monotachi (Japan) (Rev A)

objetivo: Find the eight scrolls of magic to defeat the resurrected demon dragon.
descripcion_corta: A non-linear adventure game similar to the "Zelda" style of exploration.

nombre: Dragon Scroll - Yomigaerishi Maryuu (Japan) [En by KingMike v1.0] (~Dragon Scroll - Resurrection of the Demon Dragon)

descripcion_larga: This version translates the vital NPC dialogue and clues needed to solve the game's many puzzles, making this hidden Konami gem playable for English audiences.

objetivo: Use the unique abilities of each family member to recover the Dragon Slayer sword.
descripcion_corta: Known in the West as "Legacy of the Wizard," a deep and difficult dungeon crawler.
descripcion_larga: Players control the Drasle family (and their dog). Each member has specific items they can use, requiring the player to switch characters strategically to navigate a massive, single dungeon.

objetivo: Pilot a powerful dragon to destroy the serpent demon Zawell.
descripcion_corta: A unique shooter where you control a mythical beast instead of a spaceship.

objetivo: Pilot a powerful dragon to destroy the serpent demon Zawell.

objetivo: Fight through mythical stages to rescue the princess and kill the dragon.

objetivo: Assemble a party of three descendants of Erdrick to defeat Hargon.

objetivo: Defeat the Dragonlord and recover the stolen Sphere of Light.

descripcion_corta: A unique boxing game designed for use with an inflatable peripheral.
descripcion_larga: Developed by Konami, this title was intended to be played with a physical punching bag controller, offering an early and experimental "motion control" 8-bit experience.

objetivo: Compete in international rally stages and achieve the fastest time.
descripcion_corta: A challenging top-down rally racer with official WRC-style themes.
descripcion_larga: Players must listen to co-driver cues and manage car damage across various terrains, making it one of the more realistic racing simulations on the Famicom.

nombre: Exciting Rally - World Rally Championship (Japan) [En by Klepto v1.0]
objetivo: Compete in international rally stages and achieve the fastest time.
descripcion_corta: The English translation of the technical rally simulator, Exciting Rally.
descripcion_larga: This version translates the navigator's instructions and car tuning menus, making the strategic depth of this 8-bit racer clear for international fans.

objetivo: Fly through insect-themed stages and destroy the alien swarm.
descripcion_corta: A classic Capcom arcade port featuring intense shooting and bug enemies.
descripcion_larga: Known for its high enemy density and "fruit" point bonuses, Exed Exes challenges players to survive waves of mechanical insects in a relentless 8-bit space battle.

objetivo: Defend against waves of alien ships while managing the inertia of your craft.
descripcion_corta: An early arcade port famous for its unique "momentum-based" movement.
descripcion_larga: Unlike other shooters, the ship in Exerion has weight and slides, requiring players to master the physics to accurately target enemies over a 3D-effect background.

objetivo: Compete in high-speed Formula 1 races and reach the finish line.
descripcion_corta: An early and fast-paced 8-bit take on professional open-wheel racing.
descripcion_larga: Developed by HAL Laboratory, this title focuses on pure speed and cornering, featuring multiple tracks and a challenging AI that tests the player's 8-bit driving skills.

objetivo: Master professional racing circuits to win the F1 World Championship.
descripcion_corta: One of the most technically advanced racing games on the Famicom.
descripcion_larga: Also known as Formula 1 Sensation, it features real-world tracks, car customization, and impressive scaling graphics that provide a sense of high-speed immersion.

objetivo: Complete various modern air combat missions across the globe.
descripcion_corta: A complex and realistic flight simulator based on the famous fighter jet.
descripcion_larga: Players must manage radar, multiple weapon systems, and flight controls in a first-person cockpit view, engaging in dogfights and bombing runs in several theaters of war.

objetivo: Complete various modern air combat missions across the globe.
descripcion_corta: La version française du simulateur de combat aérien F-15 Strike Eagle.
descripcion_larga: This localized version allows French-speaking players to navigate the complex cockpit controls and mission objectives of this 8-bit military simulation.

objetivo: Complete various modern air combat missions across the globe.
descripcion_corta: La versione italiana del simulatore di volo militare F-15 Strike Eagle.
descripcion_larga: This Italian edition brings the intense aerial combat and strategic mission planning of the F-15 to the local NES market with translated materials.

objetivo: Complete various modern air combat missions across the globe.
descripcion_corta: Den svenska versionen av den avancerade flygsimulatorn F-15 Strike Eagle.
descripcion_larga: Localized for the Scandinavian market, this version offers the same deep military simulation and cockpit-based action for fans of 8-bit flight games.

descripcion_corta: A complex and realistic flight simulator based on the famous fighter jet.
descripcion_larga: Players must manage radar, multiple weapon systems, and flight controls in a first-person cockpit view, engaging in dogfights and bombing runs in several theaters of war.

objetivo: Master the Formula 1 circuits and win the world championship.
descripcion_corta: A fast-paced top-down racer known for its sense of speed and technical tracks.
descripcion_larga: F1 Circus offers a professional racing experience with car tuning and realistic pit stops, challenging players to master cornering in various weather conditions on the 8-bit hardware.

objetivo: Fly through city streets and destroy enemy tanks and planes.
descripcion_corta: An unlicensed pseudo-3D flight shooter with intense action.
descripcion_larga: Published by AVE, this game features fast-paced combat where you pilot an F15 through urban landscapes, dodging buildings while locking onto targets in a relentless arcade-style battle.

objetivo: Fly through city streets and destroy enemy tanks and planes.
descripcion_corta: A revised version of the unlicensed 3D-style aerial shooter.
descripcion_larga: This updated version fixes minor graphical glitches and improves the game's stability, offering the same high-octane city-based flight combat for the NES.

nombre: Famicom Doubutsu Seitai Zukan! - Katte ni Shirokuma - Mori wo Sukue no Maki! (Japan)
objetivo: Help the polar bear Shirokuma save the forest through various tasks.
descripcion_corta: A quirky adventure based on a popular Japanese manga series.
descripcion_larga: Featuring a unique art style, players must guide Shirokuma through several levels filled with humor and mini-games to protect his animal friends and their environment.

objetivo: Learn the rules of Igo (Go) and defeat various opponents.
descripcion_corta: An introductory simulation of the classic oriental board game Go.
descripcion_larga: This title acts as a digital tutor for the complex game of Go, featuring tutorials for beginners and a computer AI to practice strategic stone placement.

objetivo: Unify the heroes of Shonen Jump to defeat an alliance of villains.
descripcion_corta: An epic crossover featuring Goku, Kenshiro, Pegasus Seiya, and more.
descripcion_larga: To celebrate the magazine's anniversary, this game blends top-down exploration with action segments, allowing players to control 16 different legendary manga protagonists.

nombre: Famicom Jump II - Saikyou no 7 Nin (Japan)
objetivo: Lead 7 chosen heroes to save the world from an ancient evil force.
descripcion_corta: A more traditional RPG sequel featuring iconic manga characters.
descripcion_larga: Developed by Chunsoft, this sequel features Goku, Jotaro Kujo, and others in a strategic grid-based combat system with a deep story and improved 8-bit graphics.

objetivo: Climb the ranks of professional Igo to reach the Meijin title.
descripcion_corta: A competitive and deep simulation of the board game Go.
descripcion_larga: Targeted at experienced players, this title features advanced AI and official tournament rules, allowing fans to test their 8-bit strategy against a digital grandmaster.

objetivo: Climb the ranks of professional Igo to reach the Meijin title.
descripcion_corta: A revised version of the professional Go simulation game.
descripcion_larga: This revision includes minor bug fixes and logic improvements to the AI, ensuring a more stable and fair competitive experience for Go enthusiasts.

objetivo: Defeat opponents in Japanese chess to win the Ryuuousen title.
descripcion_corta: A faithful simulation of Shougi, the complex Japanese chess variant.
descripcion_larga: Players can choose different difficulty levels and practice their openings and endgames in this traditional 8-bit strategy experience.

objetivo: Manage a Japanese electronics company to become a market leader.
descripcion_corta: A deep and complex corporate management simulator.
descripcion_larga: Players must handle R&D, advertising, and financial reports to grow their business, offering a unique and serious take on economic strategy on the Famicom.

objetivo: Outmaneuver the enemy army and capture their headquarters.
descripcion_corta: The English translation of the game that started the "Wars" franchise.
descripcion_larga: This translation makes the tactical menus and unit stats accessible, allowing fans to play the precursor to Advance Wars with full understanding of the mechanics.

objetivo: Outmaneuver the enemy army and capture their headquarters.
descripcion_corta: The legendary first entry in Nintendo's premier strategy series.
descripcion_larga: Featuring two warring nations (Red Star and Blue Moon), players manage land, sea, and air units on hex-based maps to achieve military dominance.

objetivo: Outmaneuver the enemy army and capture their headquarters.
descripcion_corta: An updated English version of the classic tactical war game.
descripcion_larga: This version features further refinements to the translation and fixes minor bugs, providing the smoothest English experience for this 8-bit strategy masterpiece.

objetivo: Win the professional baseball league using your team's stats.
descripcion_corta: A classic baseball game featuring real Japanese team inspirations.
descripcion_larga: Focused on the "Yakyuu Ban" board game style, it offers simple yet addictive baseball mechanics that emphasize timing and pitch selection.

objetivo: Clear all blocks using a paddle and ball across various stages.
descripcion_corta: Namco's unique take on the "Arkanoid" or "Breakout" genre.
descripcion_larga: Family Block features creative level designs and various power-ups, challenging players to master the physics of the bouncing ball to reach high scores.

objetivo: Win the heavyweight title by knocking out all your opponents.
descripcion_corta: A fast-paced 8-bit boxing game with a focus on stamina.
descripcion_larga: Known as "Ring King" in the West, this title features intense boxing action where players must manage their energy and time their punches to win the belt.

objetivo: Compete in professional racing circuits and win the championship.
descripcion_corta: A polished sequel to Namco's popular top-down racing series.
descripcion_larga: Featuring improved car customization and a variety of real-world tracks, this 1991 release offers one of the most complete racing experiences on the Famicom.

objetivo: Compete in professional racing circuits and win the championship.
descripcion_corta: The foundational title of Namco's acclaimed 8-bit racing series.
descripcion_larga: Focused on car setups and precision driving, Family Circuit established the mechanics that would define many future top-down racers in the 8-bit era.

objetivo: Flip the opponent's pieces to have the most colors on the board.
descripcion_corta: A clean and simple digital version of the classic board game Othello.
descripcion_larga: Featuring multiple difficulty levels, this game is a perfect 8-bit recreation of the "Reversi" rules, offering quick and challenging strategic matches.

objetivo: Guess the most popular survey answers to win the prize money.
descripcion_corta: An 8-bit adaptation of the famous American television game show.
descripcion_larga: Players compete as a family, answering humorous and general knowledge survey questions to reach the "Fast Money" round in this faithful TV recreation.

objetivo: Bet on or race horses to become the top jockey in the circuit.
descripcion_corta: Namco's charming and colorful take on horse racing simulation.
descripcion_larga: Blending betting strategy with arcade-style control over the horse, Family Jockey features various tracks, obstacles, and horse stats to manage.

objetivo: Win hands of Mahjong against various computer-controlled opponents.
descripcion_corta: A traditional Japanese Mahjong simulation for the Famicom.
descripcion_larga: Featuring the standard Riichi Mahjong rules, this title allows players to practice their skills against digital rivals in a clean 8-bit interface.

objetivo: Win hands of Mahjong against various computer-controlled opponents.
descripcion_corta: A revised version of Namco's initial Mahjong simulation.
descripcion_larga: This revision includes minor adjustments to the AI's logic and hand scoring to ensure a more accurate representation of the traditional game.

nombre: Family Mahjong II - Shanghai heno Michi (Japan) (Rev A)
objetivo: Win Mahjong tournaments across various cities in the "Shanghai" mode.
descripcion_corta: An expanded sequel featuring more modes and better animations.
descripcion_larga: Family Mahjong II introduces a travel mode where the player competes in different regions, adding a sense of progression to the classic tile-based strategy.

objetivo: Get the highest score across themed tables based on Namco characters.
descripcion_corta: A vibrant pinball game featuring Pac-Man and other Namco icons.
descripcion_larga: Also known as "Rock 'n' Ball" in the West, this title offers several unique tables with different physics and bonus stages, bringing a polished arcade pinball experience to the Famicom.

objetivo: Answer questions correctly to defeat opponents in a digital quiz show.
descripcion_corta: A multi-genre trivia game designed for Japanese Famicom fans.
descripcion_larga: Players choose characters and compete in various quiz categories. It’s a great example of the "social gaming" trend on the 8-bit hardware, focusing on general knowledge and quick thinking.

objetivo: Complete various academic and logic challenges to graduate.
descripcion_corta: An educational title designed to help children learn through 8-bit gaming.
descripcion_larga: This game features several mini-games focused on math, language, and logic, using the "Family" series' charming aesthetic to make learning interactive and fun.

objetivo: Win the tournament by defeating professional-style 8-bit opponents.
descripcion_corta: A fast and responsive tennis simulation, known in the West as "World Court."
descripcion_larga: Family Tennis offers tight controls and multiple court surfaces. It features a colorful cast of players and was highly praised for its realistic (for the era) ball physics.

objetivo: Follow the instructor's aerobic routines using the Power Pad.
descripcion_corta: A health-focused rhythm game that uses the Famicom's floor mat controller.
descripcion_larga: Known as "Dance Aerobics" in the US, players must step on the mat in time with the music to stay fit, offering a unique full-body workout experience on the 8-bit console.

objetivo: Compete in a series of athletic events using the Power Pad mat.
descripcion_corta: A competitive track and field game that requires physical movement.
descripcion_larga: Players use their feet to run and jump in various school-style sports events, making it a staple of the "Family Trainer" series and its physical interaction.

objetivo: Jog through city streets and parks to finish the course using the mat.
descripcion_corta: A physical jogging simulator that turns the Power Pad into a treadmill.
descripcion_larga: This game encourages players to jog in place on the mat to move their character through scenic routes, focusing on stamina and physical activity.

objetivo: Chase down criminals through the streets of New York using the mat.
descripcion_corta: A physical action game where you "run" through the city to catch crooks.
descripcion_larga: Known in the US as "Street Cop," players must step on the Power Pad to move and arrest suspects, blending traditional 8-bit action with physical exercise.

objetivo: Navigate through complex 3D-style mazes using the Power Pad.
descripcion_corta: A first-person maze game that requires physical steps to move.
descripcion_larga: Players must explore labyrinths by stepping on the mat, combining spatial puzzle-solving with physical movement in a unique 8-bit hybrid.

objetivo: Defeat the Jiangshi (hopping ghosts) using movement and items.
descripcion_corta: A physical action game based on the Chinese vampire (Kyonsee) myth.
descripcion_larga: Players use the Power Pad to navigate and fight off supernatural enemies in various themed stages, blending folklore with the unique mat-based controls.

objetivo: Defeat the Jiangshi using movement and items.
descripcion_corta: A rare prototype version of the ghost-hunting Power Pad game.
descripcion_larga: This beta offers a look at the game's development, with potential differences in enemy hitboxes or music before the final Japanese release.

objetivo: Win gold medals in various track events using the Power Pad.
descripcion_corta: The foundational Power Pad athletics game, known as "World Class Track Meet."
descripcion_larga: Famous for its 100m dash and hurdles, this title became a global hit as players literally ran in place to beat their 8-bit rivals.

nombre: Family Trainer - Totsugeki! Fuuun Takeshi Jou (Japan)
objetivo: Survive the crazy obstacles of the "Takeshi's Castle" game show.
descripcion_corta: A physical challenge game based on the legendary "Takeshi's Castle."
descripcion_larga: Players must use the Power Pad to survive the chaotic and humorous mini-games of the hit TV show, requiring both timing and physical effort.

objetivo: Complete five different physical training courses to become a master.
descripcion_corta: The first entry in the Family Trainer series, focusing on diverse physical tasks.
descripcion_larga: Athletic World features various challenges like animal hurdles and dark tunnels, designed to introduce players to the fun of the Power Pad peripheral.

objetivo: Face even crazier challenges in the sequel to the Takeshi's Castle game.
descripcion_corta: An expanded sequel with more mini-games based on the famous TV show.
descripcion_larga: This version features even more creative and difficult obstacles that require players to jump, run, and step to progress through the castle's defenses.

objetivo: Lead your team to the pennant in the 1989 Japanese league.
descripcion_corta: A refined entry in the legendary "Family Stadium" baseball series.
descripcion_larga: Featuring updated rosters and smoother animations, this '89 edition solidified Namco's dominance in the 8-bit baseball market in Japan.

objetivo: Win the championship with updated 1990 team rosters.
descripcion_corta: The first Famista of the 90s, featuring improved player logic.
descripcion_larga: Known for its accessible yet deep gameplay, Famista '90 continued the tradition of providing the most popular baseball simulation on the Famicom.

objetivo: Compete in the 1991 season with new players and team stats.
descripcion_corta: A polished 8-bit baseball title with improved graphics and faster play.
descripcion_larga: This version added more detail to the stadiums and players, keeping the series fresh for the millions of baseball fans in Japan.

objetivo: Lead your favorite team to victory in the 1992 pro baseball season.
descripcion_corta: A high-quality baseball sim featuring real-world player inspirations.
descripcion_larga: By '92, the Famista engine was incredibly polished, offering the best balance of arcade fun and sports simulation for the Famicom.

objetivo: Win the league with the most accurate 1993 team data.
descripcion_corta: One of the final and most complete 8-bit baseball games on the system.
descripcion_larga: Featuring advanced AI and a wide variety of teams, this title represents the peak of the Famista series on the 8-bit hardware.

objetivo: Compete in the final 8-bit Famicom baseball season of 1994.
descripcion_corta: The ultimate and final entry of the Famista series for the Famicom.
descripcion_larga: Released at the very end of the console's life, it features the most refined graphics and the most complete rosters ever seen in an 8-bit Famista game.

objetivo: Infiltrate enemy bases and eliminate terrorist threats.
descripcion_corta: An unlicensed Chinese action game featuring "Counter-Strike" themes.
descripcion_larga: This bootleg title attempts to capture the tactical feel of modern shooters in a side-scrolling format, featuring varied weapons and intense combat segments.

objetivo: Explore the kingdom of Zakeria to rescue Daisy and defeat the evil Zaks.
descripcion_corta: A massive, non-linear adventure featuring the famous "Egg" hero, Dizzy.
descripcion_larga: Published by Camerica, this unlicensed gem features a huge interconnected world. Players must collect items and solve inventory-based puzzles while navigating platforming challenges and various mini-games like bubble-riding and minecart races.

objetivo: Destroy all enemy bases in each zone to face the final boss.
descripcion_corta: A colorful "cute 'em up" featuring the sentient ship, Opa-Opa.
descripcion_larga: Unlike traditional shooters, players can fly both left and right. Collecting coins from defeated enemies allows players to buy weapon and engine upgrades in a mid-stage shop.

objetivo: Travel through warp holes to destroy bases in different sub-levels.
descripcion_corta: An expansive sequel to the vibrant arcade hit with more complex levels.
descripcion_larga: This sequel introduces a world-warping mechanic where players must clear bases in multiple dimensions (Bright Side and Dark Side) to progress to the area's guardian.

objetivo: Rescue the kidnapped princess and uncover the truth behind the King's curse.
descripcion_corta: A unique Famicom RPG that blends overhead travel with side-scrolling combat.
descripcion_larga: Faria is known for its steep difficulty and interesting world. Players must manage inventory, talk to villagers for clues, and master real-time combat in both top-down and action perspectives.

nombre: Faria - A World of Mystery & Danger! (USA)
objetivo: Journey to the top of the World Tree to save the Elves from the Dwarves.
descripcion_corta: A gritty and atmospheric spin-off of the "Dragon Slayer" series.
descripcion_larga: Featuring a unique brown-toned aesthetic and deep lore, players buy equipment and spells to navigate the massive branches and roots of the World Tree in a non-linear quest.

objetivo: Rescue Felix's girlfriend, Kitty, from the Professor's mechanical island.
descripcion_corta: A visually stunning platformer where Felix uses his "Magic Bag of Tricks."
descripcion_larga: Felix can transform into various vehicles (tanks, planes, submarines) by collecting hearts. It is highly praised for its smooth controls and high-quality 8-bit animations.

objetivo: Master the Formula 1 season and lead the Ferrari team to victory.
descripcion_corta: An officially licensed racing simulator focused on the Ferrari brand.
descripcion_larga: Developed by Pony Canyon, this title features real tracks and car tuning options, challenging players to manage tires and fuel while competing against professional 8-bit AI drivers.

objetivo: Navigate through Chicago to enjoy your day off without getting caught.
descripcion_corta: A rare, unreleased prototype based on the classic 80s movie.
descripcion_larga: This unreleased title shows an early attempt to bring the movie's charm to the NES, featuring level exploration and mini-games inspired by Ferris's adventures in the city.

objetivo: Capture enemy units and use them to help you infiltrate the base.
descripcion_corta: A unique tactical shooter where you turn enemies into allies.
descripcion_larga: Players control a ship that can "suck up" enemy soldiers and vehicles, allowing them to be redeployed as friendly units to create a strategic advantage on the battlefield.

objetivo: Win the world tournament with your favorite international team.
descripcion_corta: An unlicensed 8-bit port of the famous isometric soccer franchise.
descripcion_larga: This bootleg attempts to replicate the 16-bit FIFA experience on the NES, featuring a simplified isometric view and basic tournament modes for soccer fans.

nombre: Faxanadu (USA) (Rev A) [Graphic Hack by Safaribans v20070422] (Uncensored Edition)
objetivo: Master several professional courses to win the world tournament.
descripcion_corta: An early SNK golf game featuring professional player Lee Trevino.
descripcion_larga: Known for its precision controls and various terrain types, Fighting Golf allows players to choose between different golfers, each with unique power and accuracy stats.

nombre: Faxanadu (USA) [Graphic Hack by Safaribans v20070422] (Uncensored Edition)
objetivo: Fly your combat jet through enemy lines to destroy their fortress.
descripcion_corta: A fast-paced unlicensed military shooter with intense bullet patterns.
descripcion_larga: Published by Sachen, this title challenges players with relentless waves of aircraft and ground turrets, requiring quick reflexes and power-up management to survive.

nombre: Faxanadu (USA) [Hack by Ice Ranger v1.0] (~Faxanadu Facelift) (Uncensored+Color Edit)
objetivo: Lead the four Warriors of Light to restore the crystals and save the world.
descripcion_corta: The foundational epic that launched one of gaming's biggest franchises.
descripcion_larga: Final Fantasy introduced the concept of choosing a party of different classes (Warrior, Mage, etc.) and traveling across a massive world map with airships and sailing boats.

objetivo: Experience the first two epic journeys of the Warriors of Light.
descripcion_corta: A two-in-one Famicom cartridge featuring the series' origins.
descripcion_larga: This rare late-era Famicom release includes both games on a single high-capacity mapper, featuring minor bug fixes over the original stand-alone releases.

objetivo: Lead a rebellion against the Palamecian Empire and stop the Emperor.
descripcion_corta: A bold sequel that introduced a unique "stat-growth" leveling system.
descripcion_larga: Instead of traditional XP, characters improve their skills by using them. It features a more character-driven story and the first appearance of the iconic Chocobos.

objetivo: Explore a floating continent and save the world from the cloud of darkness.
descripcion_corta: The most advanced 8-bit Final Fantasy, featuring the first "Job System."
descripcion_larga: Players can switch their characters' classes at any time to adapt to different dungeons. It is famous for its massive scope, multiple world maps, and summoning magic.

objetivo: Compete in high-speed Formula 1 races across several world tracks.
descripcion_corta: A faithful Namco port of the popular arcade racing hit.
descripcion_larga: Final Lap focuses on high-speed drifting and drafting. It was one of the first NES games to allow for 2-player split-screen racing via the "link" feature on the Famicom.

objetivo: Navigate through mazes and grow your dragon by eating items.
descripcion_corta: An unlicensed Chinese game featuring classic "Snake" mechanics.
descripcion_larga: This title features colorful 8-bit graphics and multiple levels where the player must avoid their own tail and environmental hazards while growing their fire dragon.

objetivo: Lead Prince Marth and his army to reclaim the kingdom of Altea.
descripcion_corta: The legendary first entry in the premier tactical RPG series.
descripcion_larga: Fire Emblem combined RPG stat growth with grid-based strategy. It is famous for "permanent death," where losing a character in battle means they are gone for good.

objetivo: Follow Alm and Celica as they fight to end the war on Valentia.
descripcion_corta: A unique sequel that added exploration and removed some restrictions.
descripcion_larga: Gaiden (Side-story) introduced third-person town exploration and simplified item management, while maintaining the deep tactical combat and permanent death the series is known for.

objetivo: Use ice blocks to extinguish all the flames in each room.
descripcion_corta: A polished prequel to "Solomon's Key" focused on pure logic.
descripcion_larga: Known as "Solomon's Key 2" in Europe, this game challenges players to create and destroy ice blocks to navigate levels and solve increasingly complex spatial puzzles.

objetivo: Capture enemy units and use them to help you infiltrate the base.
descripcion_corta: A unique tactical shooter where you turn enemies into allies.
descripcion_larga: Players control a ship that can "suck up" enemy units, allowing them to be redeployed as friendly forces. It requires strategic management of your captured army to overcome the enemy's defenses.

objetivo: Master several professional courses to win the world tournament.
descripcion_corta: An early SNK golf game featuring professional player Lee Trevino.
descripcion_larga: Known for its precision controls and various terrain types, Fighting Golf allows players to choose between different golfers, each with unique power and accuracy stats in a realistic 8-bit environment.

objetivo: Defeat a series of martial arts experts to prove your strength.
descripcion_corta: An unlicensed fighting game for the Asian market featuring 8-bit combat.
descripcion_larga: This bootleg title attempts to bring the arcade fighting experience to the Famicom, featuring various characters with unique special moves and a traditional versus-style progression.

objetivo: Win the international martial arts tournament against tough rivals.
descripcion_corta: An unlicensed sequel with improved sprites and combat mechanics.
descripcion_larga: This third entry in the Fighting Hero series features more refined controls and larger character sprites, aiming to replicate the feel of 16-bit fighters on 8-bit hardware.

objetivo: Fight through city streets to reach and win the final tournament.
descripcion_corta: A combat-heavy action game that blends brawling with one-on-one duels.
descripcion_larga: Players navigate through side-scrolling stages fighting thugs before entering professional fighting rings, requiring mastery of various martial arts techniques and timing.

objetivo: Fly your combat jet through enemy lines to destroy their fortress.
descripcion_corta: A fast-paced unlicensed military shooter with intense bullet patterns.
descripcion_larga: Released for the Famicom by Sachen, this title challenges players with relentless waves of aircraft and ground turrets, requiring quick reflexes and power-up management.

objetivo: Fly your combat jet through enemy lines to destroy their fortress.
descripcion_corta: The NES version of the unlicensed military shooter by Sachen.
descripcion_larga: Identical in gameplay to the Famicom version, this title provides high-intensity aerial combat and challenging boss fights for the Western NES hardware.

objetivo: Lead the four Warriors of Light to restore the crystals and save the world.
descripcion_corta: The foundational epic that launched one of gaming's biggest franchises.
descripcion_larga: Final Fantasy introduced the concept of choosing a party of different classes and traveling across a massive world map with airships, defining the future of the genre.

objetivo: Lead the four Warriors of Light to restore the crystals and save the world.
descripcion_corta: A revised Japanese release of the original RPG with minor bug fixes.
descripcion_larga: This revision addresses small technical issues from the first print, ensuring a more stable experience for players embarking on the quest of the four crystals.

objetivo: Lead the four Warriors of Light to restore the crystals and save the world.
descripcion_corta: The localized North American version of the legendary Square RPG.
descripcion_larga: Published by Nintendo, this version allowed Western players to experience the deep story and strategic combat that made the series a global phenomenon.

nombre: Final Fantasy (USA) [Bug Fix by Karatorian v0.80] (Black Belt-Master Level Up Fix)
objetivo: Save the world while using a fixed version of the Black Belt class.
descripcion_corta: A technical hack that fixes the famous level-up bug for the Black Belt.
descripcion_larga: In the original game, the Black Belt's armor stat would reset under certain conditions. This fix ensures the class gains power correctly as it levels up, as originally intended.

nombre: Final Fantasy (USA) [Hack by Goongyae v1.3] (Final Facelift)
objetivo: Experience the classic quest with modernized 8-bit graphics and UI.
descripcion_corta: A visual overhaul hack that updates the sprites and menus of FF1.
descripcion_larga: This hack replaces the original character sprites and tiles with high-quality versions inspired by later entries, making the game more visually appealing for modern players.

nombre: Final Fantasy (USA) [Hack by Grond v1.1] (Balance+Bug Fixes)
objetivo: Play a more polished version of the game with hundreds of bug fixes.
descripcion_corta: A comprehensive patch that fixes broken spells and gameplay glitches.
descripcion_larga: This hack fixes iconic issues like non-working spells (TMPR, SABR) and critical hit bugs, providing the most "functional" version of the original game's mechanics.

nombre: Final Fantasy (USA) [Hack by Grond v1.2] (~Final Fantasy Plus Plus - World of Chaos)
objetivo: Navigate a vastly more difficult and altered version of the FF1 world.
descripcion_corta: A high-difficulty hack with new enemies and rearranged dungeons.
descripcion_larga: Part of the Plus Plus series, this version is designed for veterans, offering a punishing challenge with reworked stats and a more chaotic world layout.

nombre: Final Fantasy (USA) [Hack by Grond v1.5] (~Final Fantasy Plus Plus)
objetivo: Enjoy an expanded and refined version of the original adventure.
descripcion_corta: An extensive gameplay overhaul with new classes, items, and features.
descripcion_larga: This mod adds significant content to the original engine, including new character classes and rebalanced gameplay, making it feel like a modern "director's cut" of the 8-bit classic.

nombre: Final Fantasy (USA) [Hack by Kabucho v1.0] (~Quadruple Dragons)
objetivo: Complete the quest with a party specifically modified for this hack.
descripcion_corta: A themed character hack that changes the party dynamics and visuals.
descripcion_larga: This modification replaces the standard Warriors of Light with unique dragon-themed sprites and adjustments, offering a fresh aesthetic for another playthrough.

nombre: Final Fantasy (USA) [Hack by Sliver X+Thaddeus v2.0Final] (~Dragoon X Omega II)
objetivo: Survive a sci-fi epic built on the Final Fantasy engine.
descripcion_corta: A massive total conversion that turns FF1 into a space-age RPG.
descripcion_larga: Using the FF1 engine, this game features entirely new graphics, story, and world-building, proving the incredible flexibility of the 8-bit Final Fantasy framework.

objetivo: Experience the first two epic journeys of the Warriors of Light.
descripcion_corta: A two-in-one Famicom cartridge featuring the series' origins.
descripcion_larga: This late-era release includes both games on a single high-capacity cartridge, allowing players to play the first two legendary quests in one package.

nombre: Final Fantasy I & II (Japan) [En by Demiforce v1.0]
objetivo: Experience the first two epic journeys in English.
descripcion_corta: The English fan translation of the Famicom-exclusive dual cartridge.
descripcion_larga: Translated by Demiforce, this version allows English speakers to play both games with a consistent translation style on the original Famicom engine.

nombre: Final Fantasy I & II (Japan) [En by Demiforce v1.0] [Hack by Grond v1.0] (Unofficial Update)
objetivo: Experience the first two epic journeys with refined English text.
descripcion_corta: An updated version of the fan translation with improved bug fixes.
descripcion_larga: This unofficial update to the Demiforce translation fixes minor text overflows and technical glitches, providing a smoother experience for the English bundle.

objetivo: Lead a rebellion against the Palamecian Empire and stop the Emperor.
descripcion_corta: A bold sequel that introduced a unique "stat-growth" leveling system.
descripcion_larga: Instead of traditional XP, characters improve their skills by using them. It features a more character-driven story and the first appearance of Chocobos.

nombre: Final Fantasy II (Japan) [En by Demiforce v1.03] [Bug+Title Fixes by Parasyte v1.0] (Weapon-Magic Exploit Fix)
objetivo: Play the rebellion story without the famous "select-cancel" bug.
descripcion_corta: A fan-translated version of FF2 that removes the infinite stat glitch.
descripcion_larga: This version fixes the exploit where players could rapidly level up weapons by selecting and canceling attacks, forcing a more natural and balanced progression.

nombre: Final Fantasy II (Japan) [En by Demiforce v1.03] [Hack by Lenophis+King Lettuce v1.0] [Title Fix by Parasyte v1.0] (Demonic Pandemonium)
objetivo: Survive a much more difficult and dark version of the FF2 quest.
descripcion_corta: A difficulty-enhancement hack for the translated version of FF2.
descripcion_larga: This hack increases enemy power and modifies encounters to provide a "Hard Mode" experience for those who have already mastered the original Palamecian rebellion.

nombre: Final Fantasy II (Japan) [En by Demiforce v1.03] [Title Fix by Parasyte v1.0]
objetivo: Lead the rebellion with a polished English translation and title screen.
descripcion_corta: The standard English fan translation of FF2 with corrected title graphics.
descripcion_larga: Featuring the work of Demiforce and Parasyte, this is the classic way to experience the second entry of the series in English with a professional look.

objetivo: Lead a rebellion against the Palamecian Empire.
descripcion_corta: An unreleased official English prototype of the second entry.
descripcion_larga: This prototype represents the cancelled 1991 North American release. It features the unique "stat-growth" system where characters improve skills through usage rather than XP.

nombre: Final Fantasy II (USA) (Proto) [Bug Fix by Parasyte v1.0] (Weapon-Magic Exploit Fix)
objetivo: Defeat the Empire with a fixed, balanced progression system.
descripcion_corta: A patched version of the FFII prototype that removes the "select-cancel" exploit.
descripcion_larga: This version fixes the famous bug that allowed players to level up weapon and magic skills instantly, offering the intended tactical challenge of the rebellion story.

objetivo: Save the world from the Cloud of Darkness by mastering 22 character jobs.
descripcion_corta: The most advanced 8-bit FF, featuring the debut of the legendary Job System.
descripcion_larga: Final Fantasy III allows players to change character classes at any time. It features a massive world, summoning magic, and incredible technical achievements for the Famicom.

nombre: Final Fantasy III (Japan) [En by A.W.Jackson+Neill Corlett+SoM2Freak v1.1]
objetivo: Save the world from the Cloud of Darkness with full English text.
descripcion_corta: The definitive fan translation of the Famicom's most ambitious RPG.
descripcion_larga: This translation by Neill Corlett and others allows English speakers to experience the deep story and complex mechanics of the original FF3 for the first time.

objetivo: Join Cloud and AVALANCHE to stop Shinra and Sephiroth.
descripcion_corta: An infamous unlicensed "demake" of the PlayStation classic for the NES.
descripcion_larga: Developed by Shenzhen Nanjing, this title attempts to port the entire PS1 story to 8-bit, featuring a unique combat system and MIDI-style recreations of the iconic soundtrack.

nombre: Final Fantasy VII (China) (Unl) [En by Xaronyr EnCardier v0.97]
objetivo: Join Cloud and AVALANCHE to stop Shinra and Sephiroth in English.
descripcion_corta: An English-translated version of the Chinese FFVII demake.
descripcion_larga: This fan translation makes the dialogue and menus of the ambitious bootleg accessible, allowing fans to play through the 8-bit version of Cloud's journey.

objetivo: Outpace rivals in high-speed Formula 1 circuits.
descripcion_corta: A faithful Namco port of the popular arcade racing hit.
descripcion_larga: Final Lap focuses on high-speed drifting and drafting. It was one of the first NES games to support split-screen racing via the Famicom's expansion port.

objetivo: Fight through futuristic war zones to stop an alien invasion.
descripcion_corta: The original Japanese version of what became "S.C.A.T." in the West.
descripcion_larga: Featuring jetpack-based movement and orbiting satellite orbs, Final Mission is known for its intense action, great co-op mode, and impressive industrial visual design.

nombre: Final Mission (Japan) [En by Stardust Crusaders v1.0]
objetivo: Fight through futuristic war zones with translated story elements.
descripcion_corta: An English fan translation that preserves the original Japanese difficulty.
descripcion_larga: This version keeps the harder difficulty and original cutscenes of Final Mission while making the narrative accessible to English-speaking players.

objetivo: Win the baseball championship using specialized 8-bit teams.
descripcion_corta: An unlicensed Chinese baseball game with simplified arcade mechanics.
descripcion_larga: Featuring fast-paced pitching and batting, this bootleg title offers a quick baseball experience for those looking for an alternative to the mainstream sports titles.

objetivo: Use ice blocks to extinguish all the flames in each room.
descripcion_corta: A polished prequel to "Solomon's Key" focused on pure logic.
descripcion_larga: Players must create and destroy ice blocks to navigate levels and solve increasingly complex spatial puzzles across several colorful and themed 8-bit worlds.

objetivo: Grow your dragon and avoid obstacles in a variety of mazes.
descripcion_corta: An unlicensed Chinese "Snake" variant with colorful graphics.
descripcion_larga: This title features multiple levels and power-ups, challenging players to collect items and grow their fire dragon without crashing into walls or their own tail.

nombre: Fire Emblem - Ankoku Ryuu to Hikari no Tsurugi (English)
objetivo: Lead Prince Marth to reclaim Altea and defeat the Shadow Dragon.
descripcion_corta: The first English translation of the legendary strategy-RPG debut.
descripcion_larga: This version brings the foundational tactical combat and permanent death mechanics of the Fire Emblem series to English-speaking strategy fans.

nombre: Fire Emblem - Ankoku Ryuu to Hikari no Tsurugi (Japan)
objetivo: Lead Prince Marth to reclaim Altea and defeat the Shadow Dragon.
descripcion_corta: The legendary first entry in the premier tactical RPG series.
descripcion_larga: Fire Emblem combined RPG stat growth with grid-based strategy, setting the standard for the genre with its deep story and high-stakes combat.

objetivo: Lead Prince Marth to reclaim Altea and defeat the Shadow Dragon.
descripcion_corta: A revised Japanese release with minor technical fixes.
descripcion_larga: This revision ensures smoother performance and addresses small bugs in the original 1990 release of Prince Marth's iconic tactical adventure.

objetivo: Lead Prince Marth to reclaim Altea and defeat the Shadow Dragon.
descripcion_corta: An early, partially translated version of the first Fire Emblem.
descripcion_larga: This version serves as a historical look at the fan-translation scene, offering a look at the early efforts to bring Marth's story to the West.

objetivo: Lead Prince Marth to reclaim Altea and defeat the Shadow Dragon.
descripcion_corta: A high-quality and complete English translation of the first FE title.
descripcion_larga: This polished translation allows players to fully understand the intricate plot and tactical nuances of the Famicom's most influential strategy game.

objetivo: Follow Alm and Celica as they fight to end the war on Valentia.
descripcion_corta: A unique sequel that added exploration and removed some restrictions.
descripcion_larga: Gaiden introduced third-person town exploration and simplified item management, while maintaining the deep tactical combat and permanent death mechanics.

nombre: Fire Emblem Gaiden (Japan) [En by J2e v0.97b2] [Fix by Starwolfs]
objetivo: Follow Alm and Celica with a fully translated and bug-fixed script.
descripcion_corta: A highly refined English translation of the second Fire Emblem.
descripcion_larga: This version fixes text glitches and ensures a smooth narrative experience, making the non-traditional mechanics of Gaiden easy to enjoy in English.

objetivo: Pilot a combat helicopter to destroy enemy targets and rescue allies.
descripcion_corta: An intense unlicensed helicopter shooter by Codemasters.
descripcion_larga: Featuring impressive scrolling and a variety of weapon upgrades, Fire Hawk challenges players to navigate through hostile territory while managing fuel and ammo.

objetivo: Drive the fire truck and rescue kittens from trees or people from fires.
descripcion_corta: A simple and fun educational game for young children.
descripcion_larga: Designed for a younger audience, this title uses basic controls and clear visuals to teach problem-solving and navigation through firehouse-themed missions.

objetivo: Match pairs of cards to reveal pictures and earn points.
descripcion_corta: A digital "Concentration" style memory game for kids.
descripcion_larga: Featuring colorful icons and simple 8-bit melodies, this game helps children develop memory skills by finding matching pairs within a grid of cards.

objetivo: Match shapes and objects into their correct slots to clear the screen.
descripcion_corta: A shape-recognition puzzle game designed for early childhood learning.
descripcion_larga: This title focuses on visual matching and spatial reasoning, offering a friendly and non-competitive environment for children to learn basic geometric concepts.

objetivo: Defeat the gangs of the wasteland and confront your rival, Shin.
descripcion_corta: A martial arts action game based on the legendary "Hokuto no Ken" anime.
