descripcion_larga: As Kenshiro, players punch and kick through levels, causing enemies to explode. It is known for its high difficulty and iconic 8-bit martial arts action.

objetivo: Push the blue stone onto the yellow platform to clear each level.
descripcion_corta: A challenging 8-bit logic game featuring 200 levels of block-pushing fun.
descripcion_larga: Players must navigate obstacles and enemies while strategically moving stones. It requires careful planning to avoid getting trapped, offering a pure test of 8-bit spatial reasoning.

objetivo: Lead your fleet to victory in tactical sea battles across various scenarios.
descripcion_corta: A deep and technical naval warfare simulator for the Famicom.
descripcion_larga: Developed by ASCII, this game focuses on fleet positioning, radar management, and strategic strikes, providing a serious military simulation experience on the hardware.

objetivo: Complete dangerous bombing missions during the Vietnam War.
descripcion_corta: A realistic military flight simulator based on the famous novel and film.
descripcion_larga: Players control both the A-6 Intruder and the F-4 Phantom, managing cockpit instruments, radar, and carrier landings across multiple historical mission profiles.

nombre: Flintstones, The - The Rescue of Dino & Hoppy (Europe)
objetivo: Find the scattered pieces of the time machine to rescue Dino and Hoppy.
descripcion_corta: A high-quality platformer featuring Fred Flintstone and his Bedrock world.
descripcion_larga: Developed by Taito, this game is praised for its colorful graphics and clever mechanics, such as Fred's ability to grab ledges and use various Stone Age gadgets.

nombre: Flintstones, The - The Rescue of Dino & Hoppy (Japan)
objetivo: Find the scattered pieces of the time machine to rescue Dino and Hoppy.
descripcion_corta: The original Japanese release of the polished Flintstones adventure.
descripcion_larga: Featuring the same high-tier production values as the Western versions, this Famicom title captures the charm of the cartoon with great 8-bit animations.

nombre: Flintstones, The - The Rescue of Dino & Hoppy (USA)
objetivo: Find the scattered pieces of the time machine to rescue Dino and Hoppy.
descripcion_corta: A high-quality platformer featuring Fred Flintstone and his Bedrock world.
descripcion_larga: Developed by Taito, this game is praised for its colorful graphics and clever mechanics, such as Fred's ability to grab ledges and use various Stone Age gadgets.

nombre: Flintstones, The - The Surprise at Dinosaur Peak! (Europe)
objetivo: Stop a futuristic developer from turning Bedrock into a resort.
descripcion_corta: The second Flintstones NES title, featuring even more polished gameplay.
descripcion_larga: Known for its high rarity, this late-release allows players to switch between Fred and Barney, each with unique abilities needed to solve environmental puzzles.

nombre: Flintstones, The - The Surprise at Dinosaur Peak! (USA)
objetivo: Stop a futuristic developer from turning Bedrock into a resort.
descripcion_corta: One of the rarest and most expensive official NES titles ever released.
descripcion_larga: This version features top-notch graphics and the dual-character switching mechanic, representing the peak of 8-bit licensed platforming by Taito.

objetivo: Clear the required number of blocks by matching identical patterns.
descripcion_corta: An addictive and fast-paced puzzle game known as "Plotting" in the West.
descripcion_larga: Players throw blocks at a moving wall of tiles. It requires quick thinking and geometric strategy to create chains and clear the screen before time runs out.

objetivo: Master the Hiryu-no-Ken style to win the world martial arts tournament.
descripcion_corta: A hybrid action game that blends platforming with one-on-one combat.
descripcion_larga: Known as "Hiryu no Ken" in Japan, the game features a unique "mark" system in battles, where players must strike specific points on the opponent to deal damage.

objetivo: Fly through fantasy stages to rescue the princess from the evil king.
descripcion_corta: A bright and colorful "cute 'em up" with a medieval fantasy theme.
descripcion_larga: Developed by Sting, players control a flying hero on a quest, collecting diverse power-ups and fighting giant, whimsical bosses in a fast-paced aerial battle.

objetivo: Use your mystical powers to defeat the Dark Demon and his minions.
descripcion_corta: An evolved entry in the Culture Brain "Hiryu no Ken" fighting series.
descripcion_larga: This version features a superhero theme and enhanced combat mechanics, combining side-scrolling exploration with intense, mark-based martial arts duels.

objetivo: Transform between a robot and a jet to navigate through enemy lines.
descripcion_corta: An early Jaleco arcade port featuring a transforming protagonist.
descripcion_larga: Players must carefully manage their energy levels while switching forms to adapt to ground and air combat, fighting through a futuristic world.

objetivo: Master professional racing circuits to win the F1 World Championship.
descripcion_corta: One of the most technically advanced racing games on the NES.
descripcion_larga: Featuring real-world tracks, car customization, and impressive scaling graphics, it provides a sense of high-speed immersion that was rare on 8-bit hardware.

objetivo: Start as a rookie and earn your way to the Formula One world title.
descripcion_corta: A unique racing career simulator featuring RPG-style progression.
descripcion_larga: Players win races to earn money, buy parts, and upgrade through different car classes, from mini-cars to high-powered F1 machines across the USA.

nombre: Foton - The Ultimate Game on Planet Earth (Japan)
objetivo: Navigate a first-person space environment to destroy enemy drones.
descripcion_corta: A technical feat for the Famicom, featuring early 3D wireframe visuals.
descripcion_larga: Based on a Japanese sci-fi franchise, Foton tasks players with navigating a vector-style space combat zone, requiring precision aiming and navigation.

nombre: Foton - The Ultimate Game on Planet Earth (Japan) [En by KingMike v1.0Beta] (~Soldier of Light Photon)
objetivo: Navigate a first-person space environment to destroy enemy drones.
descripcion_corta: The English fan translation of the technical space shooter "Foton."
descripcion_larga: This translation makes the menus and mission briefings of the complex 3D shooter accessible, allowing players to master the vector-based combat.

objetivo: Win the grand slam tournament either solo or with up to four players.
descripcion_corta: A technical tennis simulation that supports the NES Four Score.
descripcion_larga: Known as "Top Player's Tennis" in the US, it emphasizes realistic positioning and shot types, featuring endorsements from Chris Evert and Ivan Lendl.

objetivo: Traverse the village and castle to stop the monster's creator.
descripcion_corta: A dark action-adventure game based on the gothic horror legend.
descripcion_larga: Players control a hero armed with a sword and magic, navigating through atmospheric environments filled with traps and undead enemies to confront the monster.

objetivo: Survive the ultimate clash between the two biggest horror icons.
descripcion_corta: A creative horror crossover hack that pits Freddy against Jason.
descripcion_larga: This modification of a classic engine allows fans to experience a dream match-up between the icons of A Nightmare on Elm Street and Friday the 13th in 8-bit form.

objetivo: Match shapes and clear the screen in this unreleased 8-bit puzzler.
descripcion_corta: An unreleased prototype from Vic Tokai featuring gravity-based physics.
descripcion_larga: This prototype offers a look at a canceled project where pieces fall and interact in unique ways, providing a fresh take on the classic puzzle genre.

objetivo: Take down terrorists and defuse bombs to save the city.
descripcion_corta: An intense NES Zapper game focused on precision and speed.
descripcion_larga: Players must shoot enemies while avoiding civilians, with the action moving through various urban environments in a high-stakes counter-terrorism mission.

objetivo: Protect the campers at Camp Crystal Lake and defeat Jason Voorhees.
descripcion_corta: A unique and atmospheric horror game featuring the iconic slasher.
descripcion_larga: Players switch between six different counselors, exploring cabins and woods in a race against time. It’s known for its suspenseful music and jumpscares.

objetivo: Infiltrate the enemy base on foot and in tanks to destroy the fort.
descripcion_corta: A classic Taito arcade port of one of the earliest military shooters.
descripcion_larga: Players start as a lone soldier but can find and pilot tanks to increase their firepower as they push through hazardous 8-bit battlefields.

objetivo: Use 13 different types of weapons to defeat demons and save the land.
descripcion_corta: An expansive and difficult action game by Taito with massive stages.
descripcion_larga: Known for its intense difficulty and huge variety of power-ups, players control a monk who must battle mythological creatures across vast, non-linear levels.

nombre: Fudou Myouou Den (Japan) [En by Stardust Crusaders v1.0] (~Acala Legend, The)
objetivo: Use 13 different types of weapons to defeat demons and save the land.
descripcion_corta: The English fan translation of the epic "Fudou Myouou Den."
descripcion_larga: This translation makes the many weapon upgrades and story elements clear, allowing players to tackle one of the Famicom's most challenging action titles.

objetivo: Choose from several arcade-style mini-games in one package.
descripcion_corta: A collection of unlicensed action and puzzle games by Bunch Games.
descripcion_larga: This Australian-released cartridge features a variety of simple 8-bit experiences, ranging from shooters to logic puzzles, providing multiple games on a single cart.

objetivo: Navigate a maze-like obstacle course to collect prizes and reach the exit.
descripcion_corta: An 8-bit adaptation of the popular kids' television game show.
descripcion_larga: As Tiny, players must navigate stages filled with balls and obstacles, using a launcher to hit targets and clear the way through the Fun House before time runs out.

nombre: Fushigi na Blobby - Blobania no Kiki (Japan)
objetivo: Feed your blob jellybeans to transform it and navigate obstacles.
descripcion_corta: Known in the West as "A Boy and His Blob: Trouble on Blobolonia."
descripcion_larga: This charming game requires strategic thinking as different jellybean flavors turn the blob into ladders, holes, or trampolines to help the boy save the planet.

objetivo: Join Nadia and Jean on an epic quest to stop the Neo-Atlanteans.
descripcion_corta: A deep adventure game based on the "Nadia: Secret of Blue Water" anime.
descripcion_larga: This title combines story-driven dialogue segments with tactical, grid-based combat, staying faithful to the art style and narrative of the classic Gainax series.

nombre: Fushigi no Umi no Nadia (Japan) [En by J2e v1.3] (~Nadia - Secret of the Blue Water)
objetivo: Join Nadia and Jean on an epic quest with full English text.
descripcion_corta: The English fan translation of the Famicom adventure based on the anime.
descripcion_larga: This translation makes the complex plot and tactical RPG segments accessible, allowing fans to experience the 8-bit retelling of Nadia's journey in English.

objetivo: Fly through stages and use shops to upgrade your ship's stats and magic.
descripcion_corta: A unique hybrid of traditional shooting and RPG-style progression.
descripcion_larga: Fuzzical Fighter allows players to land at shops mid-level to buy weapons and items, blending fast-paced aerial combat with strategic character building.

objetivo: Fly through stages and upgrade your ship with translated menus.
descripcion_corta: The English version of the quirky shooter-RPG hybrid.
descripcion_larga: This translation is crucial for understanding the various ship upgrades, spells, and items available in the shops, making the game's depth much easier to navigate.

nombre: G.I. Joe - A Real American Hero - The Atlantis Factor (USA)
objetivo: Lead a squad of G.I. Joe members to stop Cobra's resurrection of Atlantis.
descripcion_corta: The second G.I. Joe NES game, featuring non-linear path selection.
descripcion_larga: Players can choose different characters with unique weapons and upgrade their stats. It features massive levels and impressive boss fights against the Cobra elite.

nombre: G.I. Joe - A Real American Hero - The Atlantis Factor (USA) (Beta)
objetivo: Lead a squad to stop Cobra in this early development version.
descripcion_corta: A prototype of the second G.I. Joe game with potential gameplay differences.
descripcion_larga: This version offers a look at the game's polish before release, sometimes showing different enemy placements or unrefined character abilities.

nombre: G.I. Joe - A Real American Hero (USA)
objetivo: Infiltrate Cobra bases and plant bombs to dismantle the organization.
descripcion_corta: A top-tier action game developed by Taxan with incredible co-op and combat.
descripcion_larga: Players select a team of three Joes, switching between them to utilize different strengths. It's widely considered one of the best action titles on the NES.

objetivo: Journey through a fantasy world to find the legendary city of Gaiapolis.
descripcion_corta: An unlicensed 8-bit port of the Konami arcade fantasy brawler.
descripcion_larga: This bootleg attempts to replicate the top-down action of the original, featuring character leveling and cooperative play in a world of magic and machines.

objetivo: Pilot a starship through enemy lines to destroy a cosmic threat.
descripcion_corta: An unlicensed space shooter by Sachen with high-speed action.
descripcion_larga: This version features challenging bullet patterns and multiple power-ups, requiring quick reflexes to navigate through waves of alien spacecraft.

objetivo: Pilot a starship through enemy lines to destroy a cosmic threat.
descripcion_corta: The Western unlicensed release of the Sachen space shooter.
descripcion_larga: Released by Bunch Games, it offers the same intense arcade-style shooting, challenging players to achieve high scores in a relentless space battle.

objetivo: Destroy waves of insect-like aliens before they dive-bomb your ship.
descripcion_corta: The iconic sequel to Galaxian and a foundational arcade classic.
descripcion_larga: Famous for the "Challenge Stage" and the ability to have your ship captured and then rescued to create a "Dual Fighter" for double the firepower.

objetivo: Destroy waves of insect-like aliens before they dive-bomb your ship.
descripcion_corta: The European PAL version of the legendary Namco arcade shooter.
descripcion_larga: A pixel-perfect recreation of the arcade hit, challenging players with increasing waves of enemies and strategic ship management.

objetivo: Destroy waves of insect-like aliens before they dive-bomb your ship.
descripcion_corta: The original Famicom release of the hit arcade shooter.
descripcion_larga: This version brought the arcade experience home with perfect accuracy, becoming one of the most played and beloved titles in the Famicom library.

objetivo: Defend the galaxy from swarms of alien invaders.
descripcion_corta: The classic precursor to Galaga, featuring colorful 8-bit enemies.
descripcion_larga: Galaxian was one of the first games to feature enemies with individual dive-bombing patterns, offering a step up in difficulty from earlier fixed shooters.

objetivo: Race through intergalactic tracks and use weapons to destroy rivals.
descripcion_corta: A unique 3D-perspective racer with high-speed combat.
descripcion_larga: Players can upgrade their ships with the prize money won. The game features jumping mechanics and a humorous 8-bit digitized voice during races.

objetivo: Race through intergalactic tracks and use weapons to destroy rivals.
descripcion_corta: A unique 3D-perspective racer with high-speed combat.
descripcion_larga: Players can upgrade their ships with the prize money won. The game features jumping mechanics and a humorous 8-bit digitized voice during races.

objetivo: Search through 100 areas to find the pieces of a legendary weapon.
descripcion_corta: A shooter with exploration elements, also known as "Zunou Senkan Galg."
descripcion_larga: Unlike standard shooters, the player must choose paths at forks in the road to navigate a massive maze-like environment while fighting enemies.

nombre: Gambler Jiko Chuushin Ha - Mahjong Game (Japan)
objetivo: Defeat various quirky opponents in high-stakes Mahjong matches.
descripcion_corta: A Mahjong game based on a popular Japanese manga series.
descripcion_larga: It features a variety of characters with unique playstyles and humorous cutscenes, making the traditional tile game more accessible and entertaining.

objetivo: Continue your Mahjong career against even tougher manga rivals.
descripcion_corta: The expanded sequel to the popular manga-based Mahjong game.
descripcion_larga: This version includes more characters, refined AI, and updated graphics, focusing on the social and competitive aspects of Japanese Mahjong.

objetivo: Enter codes to modify game parameters like health or lives.
descripcion_corta: The legendary game-modifying peripheral for the NES.
descripcion_larga: While not a game itself, the Game Genie interface allowed players to bypass difficulty or explore hidden features in their favorite 8-bit titles using alphanumeric codes.

objetivo: Compete in various party-style challenges to earn the highest score.
descripcion_corta: A collection of family-oriented mini-games for the Famicom.
descripcion_larga: From sports to logic puzzles, this title was designed for multiple players to enjoy a "digital board game" experience on the couch.

objetivo: Journey across Edo-period Japan to stop a mechanical threat.
descripcion_corta: The second Goemon adventure, introducing Ebisumaru and co-op play.
descripcion_larga: This sequel expanded the world significantly, adding vehicles, massive bosses, and the iconic humorous tone that would define the Konami franchise.

nombre: Ganbare Goemon 2 (Japan) [En by Stardust Crusaders v1.0]
objetivo: Journey across Edo-period Japan with full English dialogue.
descripcion_corta: The English translation of the second Goemon Famicom classic.
descripcion_larga: This translation captures the puns and historical humor of the series, allowing Western fans to enjoy the deep levels and quirky story.

nombre: Ganbare Goemon Gaiden - Kieta Ougon Kiseru (Japan)
objetivo: Solve the mystery of the missing Golden Pipe in a fantasy Japan.
descripcion_corta: A spin-off that turns the Goemon series into a traditional RPG.
descripcion_larga: Featuring a beautiful art style and a classic turn-based combat system, this game takes the Goemon cast on a grand quest through towns and dungeons.

nombre: Ganbare Goemon Gaiden 2 - Tenka no Zaihou (Japan)
objetivo: Search for the world's treasures in an epic RPG sequel.
descripcion_corta: The second Goemon RPG, often considered one of the best on the system.
descripcion_larga: This title features even more impressive 8-bit cutscenes, a larger world, and a refined combat system, representing the peak of Famicom RPG design.

objetivo: Travel through the provinces of Japan to help the poor and fight injustice.
descripcion_corta: The first Famicom entry in the legendary Mystical Ninja series.
descripcion_larga: Players explore vast levels filled with secrets and shops. It established the core gameplay of using a pipe and throwing coins as weapons.

nombre: Ganbare Goemon! - Karakuri Douchuu (Japan) [En by Dragoon-X v1.02]
objetivo: Travel through the provinces of Japan to help the poor and fight injustice.
descripcion_corta: The English fan translation of the first Famicom "Mystical Ninja" game.
descripcion_larga: This translation makes the shops, clues, and humorous dialogue accessible, allowing players to fully enjoy Goemon's debut quest through the colorful Edo period.

objetivo: Lead your baseball team to the top of the Japanese league.
descripcion_corta: A polished Konami baseball title known for its high-quality music and animations.
descripcion_larga: This game offers a mix of realistic simulation and arcade fun, featuring detailed player stats and smooth 8-bit graphics that were a hallmark of Konami’s late Famicom era.

objetivo: Guide Sun Wukong and his companions on their journey to the West.
descripcion_corta: A cult classic based on the "Journey to the West" legend.
descripcion_larga: Players must manage the party's health and hunger while navigating top-down maps and side-scrolling action sequences, staying true to the famous mythological source material.

objetivo: Protect the world from robotic invaders using your high-tech armor.
descripcion_corta: An unlicensed action game featuring a futuristic hero in a world of machines.
descripcion_larga: This bootleg title focuses on combat and platforming, challenging players to destroy waves of drones and robotic bosses using a variety of projectile weapons.

objetivo: Survive a full week of Monday-to-Sunday adventures as Garfield.
descripcion_corta: A notoriously difficult Japanese-exclusive platformer featuring the lazy cat.
descripcion_larga: Garfield must kick mice and birds across various domestic and outdoor environments. It is famous for its punishing difficulty and unique take on the comic character.

nombre: Garfield - A Week of Garfield Upgrade
objetivo: Experience Garfield's week with improved physics and fair difficulty.
descripcion_corta: A technical hack that balances the original "Week of Garfield" gameplay.
descripcion_larga: This modification improves Garfield's movement speed, attack range, and hit detection, making the challenging Japanese classic much more playable and enjoyable.

objetivo: Race as Garfield and friends in this 8-bit kart racing conversion.
descripcion_corta: A creative hack of "Mickey's Adventure in Numberland" or similar engines.
descripcion_larga: This total conversion replaces characters and assets to create a Garfield-themed racing experience, complete with custom sprites and themed 8-bit tracks.

nombre: Gargoyle's Quest II - The Demon Darkness (Europe)
objetivo: Embark on a journey as Firebrand to save the Ghoul Realm.
descripcion_corta: A high-quality Capcom prequel featuring unique hovering mechanics.
descripcion_larga: As a gargoyle, players can fly, cling to walls, and breathe fire. The game blends top-down RPG exploration with intense side-scrolling action stages and incredible music.

nombre: Gargoyle's Quest II - The Demon Darkness (USA)
objetivo: Embark on a journey as Firebrand to save the Ghoul Realm.
descripcion_corta: A high-quality Capcom prequel featuring unique hovering mechanics.
descripcion_larga: As a gargoyle, players can fly, cling to walls, and breathe fire. The game blends top-down RPG exploration with intense side-scrolling action stages and incredible music.

objetivo: Navigate endless mazes to find the exit while fighting off hordes of monsters.
descripcion_corta: The official Tengen port of the legendary co-op arcade hit.
descripcion_larga: Players choose between the Warrior, Valkyrie, Wizard, or Elf. The game is famous for the narrator's voice ("Wizard needs food, badly!") and its relentless enemy spawners.

objetivo: Navigate endless mazes to find the exit while fighting off hordes of monsters.
descripcion_corta: The unlicensed version of the arcade classic, released by Tengen.
descripcion_larga: Due to legal disputes with Nintendo, this version was released in a black cartridge, featuring the same intense four-player-inspired dungeon-crawling action.

objetivo: Survive deeper and more complex dungeons with up to four players.
descripcion_corta: An improved sequel that allows four-player simultaneous play.
descripcion_larga: Using the NES Four Score, players can team up to tackle even more enemies, featuring voice synthesis and the ability for multiple players to choose the same class.

objetivo: Survive deeper and more complex dungeons with up to four players.
descripcion_corta: An improved sequel that allows four-player simultaneous play.
descripcion_larga: Using the NES Four Score, players can team up to tackle even more enemies, featuring voice synthesis and the ability for multiple players to choose the same class.

nombre: Gegege no Kitarou - Youkai Dai Makyou (Japan)
objetivo: Use Kitaro's supernatural powers to defeat evil Yokai across Japan.
descripcion_corta: A popular action game based on the famous spooky manga series.
descripcion_larga: Known in the US as "Ninja Kid," the original version features Kitaro using his hair-needles and remote-control sandals to fight traditional Japanese ghosts.

nombre: Gegege no Kitarou - Youkai Dai Makyou (Japan) (Beta)
objetivo: Defeat evil Yokai in this early development version of the game.
descripcion_corta: A rare prototype featuring differences in level layout and enemy design.
descripcion_larga: This beta offers a glimpse into the production of the first Kitaro game, showcasing early sprite work and mechanical adjustments before the retail release.

nombre: Gegege no Kitarou - Youkai Dai Makyou (Japan) [En by Aishsha v1.0] (~Spooky Kitaro in the Yokai World)
objetivo: Defeat the Yokai army with Kitaro's hair-needles and translated text.
descripcion_corta: The English fan translation of the first Kitaro Famicom title.
descripcion_larga: This version restores the original Japanese cultural context and character names, providing the definitive way to play the first game in English.

nombre: Gegege no Kitarou 2 - Youkai Gundan no Chousen (Japan)
objetivo: Travel across Japan to stop a massive Yokai invasion.
descripcion_corta: A sequel that shifts the series into a traditional RPG format.
descripcion_larga: Unlike the first game, this entry focuses on turn-based battles and world exploration, featuring many iconic characters from the Shigeru Mizuki universe.

nombre: Gegege no Kitarou 2 - Youkai Gundan no Chousen (Japan) [En by Aishsha+Djinn v1.1] (~Spooky Kitaro 2 - Kitaro Versus Yokai Army)
objetivo: Stop the Yokai invasion with translated dialogue and menus.
descripcion_corta: The English fan translation of the expansive Famicom RPG sequel.
descripcion_larga: This translation is essential for understanding the various Yokai abilities and the story-driven quests that take Kitaro all over the map of Japan.

objetivo: Pilot a starship and destroy the core of the mechanical planet.
descripcion_corta: An early experiment in 3D perspective shooting on the Famicom.
descripcion_larga: Players fly towards the horizon, dodging and shooting enemies in a style similar to "Space Harrier," but with a focus on clearing planetary defenses.

objetivo: Defeat the Foot Clan and save Splinter as the Ninja Turtles.
descripcion_corta: The Japanese version of the first TMNT game for the NES.
descripcion_larga: Known for its high difficulty (especially the dam level), players can switch between the four turtles at any time, each with their own health bar and weapon.

objetivo: Smash enemy cars out of the arena to be the last one standing.
descripcion_corta: A chaotic and fun 8-bit "demolition derby" style game.
descripcion_larga: Players drive 4WD vehicles in various arenas, using speed and environmental hazards to destroy opponents in fast-paced, high-energy rounds.

objetivo: Climb the ranks to become the champion of the Toukon federation.
descripcion_corta: A technical wrestling game featuring the legendary Antonio Inoki.
descripcion_larga: It features a variety of grapples and strikes, requiring precise timing and button sequences to wear down opponents in the 8-bit squared circle.

objetivo: Win the championship in this high-energy baseball simulation.
descripcion_corta: A fast-paced baseball game with a focus on dramatic plays.
descripcion_larga: This title offers a more arcade-like feel than Famista, featuring exaggerated batting animations and a heavy emphasis on timing and power.

objetivo: Unify the island of Ishmeria by reclaiming the 7 wizard gems.
descripcion_corta: A fantasy-themed grand strategy game from the masters at Koei.
descripcion_larga: Players manage units, diplomacy, and resources. The game features a unique system where powerful wizards and monsters can be summoned to turn the tide of tactical grid-based battles.

objetivo: Conquer the known world as Temujin and build a lasting empire.
descripcion_corta: A deep historical simulation of the Mongol Empire's rise to power.
descripcion_larga: This complex Koei title requires managing family succession, international trade, and military campaigns across two different world maps (Mongolia and Eurasia).

objetivo: Defeat the Heike clan in a digital board game based on Japanese lore.
descripcion_corta: A strategic board game adaptation of the famous Namco arcade title.
descripcion_larga: Players move across a map of Japan, engaging in mini-games and tactical battles to weaken the enemy's influence, all presented with a distinct traditional aesthetic.

objetivo: Win the heavyweight championship by knocking out every contender.
descripcion_corta: A punch-heavy boxing game endorsed by the legendary George Foreman.
descripcion_larga: Featuring large character sprites and a focus on power punches, players must manage stamina and timing to climb the professional ranks in this PAL version.

objetivo: Win the heavyweight championship by knocking out every contender.
descripcion_corta: A punch-heavy boxing game endorsed by the legendary George Foreman.
descripcion_larga: Featuring large character sprites and a focus on power punches, players must manage stamina and timing to climb the professional ranks on the NES.

objetivo: Journey through the underworld to defeat the demon Ryukotsuki.
descripcion_corta: A legendary Konami adventure featuring side-scrolling and 3D paths.
descripcion_larga: As Getsu Fuu, players collect three pulse swords across a massive map. It is famous for its "3D dungeon" segments and its heavy influence on the Castlevania series.

objetivo: Journey through the underworld with full English translated lore.
descripcion_corta: The English fan translation of the cult classic Getsufuu Maden.
descripcion_larga: This translation makes the clues, item descriptions, and mythological story accessible, allowing Western fans to enjoy one of Konami's best Famicom exclusives.

objetivo: Rescue Princess Prin-Prin from the demon king as Sir Arthur.
descripcion_corta: The notoriously difficult and iconic Capcom arcade port.
descripcion_larga: Known for its steep challenge, players must guide Arthur through graveyards and caves. You must beat the game twice to see the true ending!

nombre: Ghost'n Goblins (Europe) [Hack by Plimoth Legaue v1.0] (~All Hallows Eve)
objetivo: Experience a spooky Halloween-themed version of the Capcom classic.
descripcion_corta: A total visual overhaul of Ghost'n Goblins with seasonal graphics.
descripcion_larga: This hack replaces tiles and sprites to create a festive Halloween atmosphere, while maintaining the legendary difficulty of the original NES game.

objetivo: Earn enough money to enter the Zuul building and save New York.
descripcion_corta: The Japanese version of the famous movie tie-in by Activision.
descripcion_larga: This version features slightly different graphics and ending screens, but keeps the core gameplay of driving the Ecto-1 and trapping ghosts for cash.

objetivo: Earn enough money to enter the Zuul building and save New York.
descripcion_corta: The famous movie tie-in known for its unique driving and trapping.
descripcion_larga: Players buy equipment, drive through the city, and capture ghosts. It is remembered for its innovative (if frustrating) mechanics and the iconic theme music.

objetivo: Stop the flow of pink slime and defeat Vigo the Carpathian.
descripcion_corta: An improved sequel featuring different gameplay styles for each level.
descripcion_larga: Unlike the first game, this version focuses on side-scrolling action and vehicle stages (like the Statue of Liberty), following the plot of the second movie.

objetivo: Stop the flow of pink slime and defeat Vigo the Carpathian.
descripcion_corta: An improved sequel featuring different gameplay styles for each level.
descripcion_larga: Unlike the first game, this version focuses on side-scrolling action and vehicle stages (like the Statue of Liberty), following the plot of the second movie.

objetivo: Save NYC with improved graphics and fixed gameplay mechanics.
descripcion_corta: A "Real" Ghostbusters hack that polishes the original NES game.
descripcion_larga: This remaster fixes bugs, updates colors to match the cartoon, and adjusts the difficulty to make the classic Activision title more enjoyable today.

objetivo: Rescue Princess Prin-Prin from the demon king as Sir Arthur.
descripcion_corta: The notoriously difficult and iconic Capcom arcade port.
descripcion_larga: Known for its steep challenge, players must guide Arthur through graveyards and caves. You must beat the game twice to see the true ending!

objetivo: Enjoy the adventure of Sir Arthur with a more forgiving difficulty.
descripcion_corta: A balanced hack that reduces the frustration of the original game.
descripcion_larga: This version modifies enemy spawns and Arthur's resilience, allowing players to experience the levels without the extreme 8-bit punishment.

objetivo: Breeze through the demon realm with maximum health and lives.
descripcion_corta: A "tourist mode" hack for the notoriously hard Capcom classic.
descripcion_larga: Perfect for seeing the game's art and level design, this version makes Arthur almost invincible, removing the barriers of the original arcade difficulty.

objetivo: Rescue your girlfriend from a high school overrun by demons.
descripcion_corta: A non-linear "Metroidvania" style action game set in a school.
descripcion_larga: Players explore classrooms and gyms, finding various weapons and items to unlock new areas. It’s known for its unique setting and strange enemy designs.

nombre: Gimmi a Break - Shijou Saikyou no Quiz Ou Ketteisen (Japan)
objetivo: Win the ultimate quiz championship by answering varied questions.
descripcion_corta: A Japanese quiz game featuring a high-energy TV show format.
descripcion_larga: This title tests general knowledge across several categories, requiring quick reflexes and deep cultural knowledge to beat the digital opponents.

nombre: Gimmi a Break - Shijou Saikyou no Quiz Ou Ketteisen 2 (Japan)
objetivo: Defend your title in the expanded quiz show sequel.
descripcion_corta: A second installment of the popular Famicom trivia series.
descripcion_larga: Featuring updated questions and new mini-games, this sequel offers a refined experience for fans of digital 8-bit board games and trivia.

objetivo: Journey through a toy world to save your owner from a kidnapping.
descripcion_corta: A technical masterpiece known for its advanced physics and sound.
descripcion_larga: Players use stars to jump and attack. The game features the Sunsoft 5B chip for enhanced music and is legendary for its hidden "true" final level.

objetivo: Choose between the Empire or the Alliance in a galactic war.
descripcion_corta: A strategy game based on the "Legend of the Galactic Heroes" anime.
descripcion_larga: Players manage fleets and engage in massive space battles, staying faithful to the political and tactical depth of the famous sci-fi series.

objetivo: Lead a crew to defend Earth from an invading alien force.
descripcion_corta: A sci-fi RPG featuring unique first-person space combat.
descripcion_larga: Known for its atmospheric soundtrack and futuristic setting, players travel between planets to gather information and upgrade their combat mechs.

objetivo: Complete missions with a team of female heroes.
descripcion_corta: A character swap hack that introduces new protagonists to a classic engine.
descripcion_larga: This work-in-progress hack replaces traditional characters with female sprites, offering a fresh aesthetic for 8-bit platforming fans.

objetivo: Clear the field of items while avoiding enemies in this bootleg title.
descripcion_corta: An unlicensed action game featuring a simple, arcade-style loop.
descripcion_larga: This title focuses on high scores and quick reflexes, challenging players to navigate small arenas and outsmart the AI in a series of fast-paced rounds.

objetivo: Win the world tournament by mastering the field with your team.
descripcion_corta: A fast and accessible 8-bit soccer game by Jaleco.
descripcion_larga: Featuring multiple formations and tournament modes, Goal! is praised for its smooth controls and the ability to add "curve" to the ball after a shot.

objetivo: Win the world tournament by mastering the field with your team.
descripcion_corta: A fast and accessible 8-bit soccer game by Jaleco.
descripcion_larga: Featuring multiple formations and tournament modes, Goal! is praised for its smooth controls and the ability to add "curve" to the ball after a shot.

objetivo: Lead your international team to the cup in this polished sequel.
descripcion_corta: An improved soccer simulation with better graphics and AI.
descripcion_larga: Goal! Two expanded on the original with more teams, better pitch perspectives, and refined controls for headers and bicycle kicks.

objetivo: Win the league or tournament with your favorite soccer team.
descripcion_corta: The original Famicom version of the fast-paced Jaleco soccer game.
descripcion_larga: Known for its smooth scrolling and "after-touch" mechanic that allows players to curve the ball mid-air, it offers a very accessible 8-bit football experience.

objetivo: Defeat the gods of Olympus as Kratos in 8-bit form.
descripcion_corta: An unlicensed Chinese "demake" of the famous PlayStation title.
descripcion_larga: This bootleg attempts to bring the fury of Kratos to the NES, featuring unique sprites, multiple weapons, and simplified versions of the epic boss battles.

objetivo: Continue Kratos's revenge against the gods in this 8-bit sequel.
descripcion_corta: Another ambitious unlicensed port of the Sony action franchise.
descripcion_larga: Featuring improved graphics over the first bootleg, it focuses on high-intensity combat and platforming through mythological Greek environments.

nombre: God Slayer - Haruka Tenkuu no Sonata (Japan)
objetivo: Awaken from cryogenic sleep to save a post-apocalyptic world.
descripcion_corta: The original Japanese version of the cult classic "Crystalis."
descripcion_larga: Developed by SNK, this masterpiece features real-time combat, a deep magic system, and an epic story that combines fantasy with sci-fi elements.

objetivo: Travel across the solar system to defeat King Ghidorah's army.
descripcion_corta: A unique hybrid of board game strategy and giant monster combat.
descripcion_larga: Players move Godzilla and Mothra across a grid. When encountering an enemy, the game switches to a side-scrolling battle against iconic Kaiju and mechanical bosses.

objetivo: Travel across the solar system to defeat King Ghidorah's army.
descripcion_corta: A unique hybrid of board game strategy and giant monster combat.
descripcion_larga: Players move Godzilla and Mothra across a grid. When encountering an enemy, the game switches to a side-scrolling battle against iconic Kaiju and mechanical bosses.

objetivo: Defend Earth from invading monsters across the galaxy.
descripcion_corta: The original Famicom release of the strategic Kaiju adventure.
descripcion_larga: Featuring a massive roster of classic monsters, this title is beloved for its atmosphere and the chance to control the King of the Monsters on 8-bit hardware.

objetivo: Coordinate military forces to stop Godzilla and other invading monsters.
descripcion_corta: A pure tactical simulation where you play as the human defense force.
descripcion_larga: Unlike the first game, you control the army. You must strategically deploy tanks and jets to lure and damage giant monsters attacking major cities.

objetivo: Win gold in various summer Olympic events against world rivals.
descripcion_corta: A massive Capcom sports collection featuring 18 different events.
descripcion_larga: Players compete in track, field, swimming, and gymnastics. It’s known for its varied gameplay mechanics and its great 4-player competitive mode.

objetivo: Win gold in various summer Olympic events against world rivals.
descripcion_corta: A massive Capcom sports collection featuring 18 different events.
descripcion_larga: Players compete in track, field, swimming, and gymnastics. It’s known for its varied gameplay mechanics and its great 4-player competitive mode.

objetivo: Lead Isaac and his friends on a quest to stop the release of Alchemy.
descripcion_corta: An unlicensed 8-bit "demake" of the Game Boy Advance classic.
descripcion_larga: This Chinese bootleg recreates the story and world of Golden Sun, featuring a surprisingly complex turn-based battle system for an unlicensed NES title.

objetivo: Master the professional circuit to win the 1992 championship.
descripcion_corta: A late-era Famicom golf game with refined physics and menus.
descripcion_larga: It offers a more technical approach to golf, with detailed wind and terrain data, catering to fans of serious sports simulations on the 8-bit system.

objetivo: Complete 18 holes in the fewest strokes possible.
descripcion_corta: The foundational Nintendo sports title that defined the genre's controls.
descripcion_larga: Featuring the iconic "three-click" power meter that is still used today, this classic allows players to select clubs and adjust for wind on a variety of greens.

objetivo: Complete 18 holes in the fewest strokes possible.
descripcion_corta: The foundational Nintendo sports title that defined the genre's controls.
descripcion_larga: Featuring the iconic "three-click" power meter that is still used today, this classic allows players to select clubs and adjust for wind on a variety of greens.

objetivo: Complete 18 holes in the fewest strokes possible.
descripcion_corta: The foundational Nintendo sports title that defined the genre's controls.
descripcion_larga: Featuring the iconic "three-click" power meter that is still used today, this classic allows players to select clubs and adjust for wind on a variety of greens.

objetivo: Compete in tournament play and achieve a birdy on every hole.
descripcion_corta: A fast and colorful arcade-style golf game by Data East.
descripcion_larga: Birdy Rush offers a more upbeat and faster experience than Nintendo's Golf, featuring overhead views and simplified mechanics for quick play.

objetivo: Win all four major tournaments to achieve the Grand Slam.
descripcion_corta: A comprehensive golf simulation with multiple professional modes.
descripcion_larga: This title focuses on the career aspect of golf, challenging players to master different courses and weather conditions to become the world number one.

objetivo: Win all four major tournaments to achieve the Grand Slam.
descripcion_corta: A comprehensive golf simulation with multiple professional modes.
descripcion_larga: This title focuses on the career aspect of golf, challenging players to master different courses and weather conditions to become the world number one.

objetivo: Win the open tournament and set new course records.
descripcion_corta: A specialized golf title featuring unique Japanese courses.
descripcion_larga: Like many Famicom golf games, it emphasizes precision and course management, offering a high-quality 8-bit simulation for golf enthusiasts.

nombre: Golgo 13 - Dai 1 Shou - Kamigami no Tasogare (Japan)
objetivo: Complete top-secret missions as the world's greatest assassin.
descripcion_corta: The original Japanese version of the first Golgo 13 game.
descripcion_larga: A complex hybrid that switches between side-scrolling action, first-person maze exploration, and sniper segments. It is famous for its mature themes and story.

objetivo: Stop a global satellite threat in this high-stakes sequel.
descripcion_corta: The second Golgo 13 NES title, featuring improved graphics.
descripcion_larga: Duke Togo returns in this adventure that takes him across the world. It refined the maze exploration and added more cinematic cutscenes to the 8-bit experience.

objetivo: Uncover the mystery of the Icarus project as Duke Togo.
descripcion_corta: The Japanese version of the high-octane "Mafat Conspiracy."
descripcion_larga: Known for its challenging first-person segments and tactical sniper gameplay, this Famicom title is a classic of the espionage genre.

objetivo: Complete top-secret missions as the world's greatest assassin.
descripcion_corta: The North American version of the first Golgo 13 adventure.
descripcion_larga: Despite some censorship, the game remains a unique blend of genres, challenging players to think like a professional hitman in a world of 8-bit international intrigue.

objetivo: Connect five stones in a row before your opponent does.
descripcion_corta: A clean and simple digital version of the traditional Go-moku game.
descripcion_larga: Featuring a challenging computer AI, this early Famicom title is a perfect recreation of the classic board game, requiring deep strategic planning.

nombre: Goonies II, The - Fratelli Saigo no Chousen (Japan)
objetivo: Save your fellow Goonies and a mermaid from the Fratelli family.
descripcion_corta: An expansive sequel that blends platforming with first-person puzzles.
descripcion_larga: Players explore a massive interconnected world (hide-and-seek style) using tools like hammers and glasses to find hidden paths and rescue their friends.

nombre: Goonies II, The - Fratelli Saigo no Chousen (Japan) (Beta)
objetivo: Save the Goonies in this early development version of the game.
descripcion_corta: A rare prototype featuring differences in item locations and text.
descripcion_larga: This version offers a look at Konami's development process, showing minor balance changes and layout adjustments before the final retail release.

objetivo: Save your fellow Goonies and a mermaid from the Fratelli family.
descripcion_corta: An expansive sequel that blends platforming with first-person puzzles.
descripcion_larga: Players explore a massive interconnected world (hide-and-seek style) using tools like hammers and glasses to find hidden paths and rescue their friends.

objetivo: Save your fellow Goonies and a mermaid from the Fratelli family.
descripcion_corta: An expansive sequel that blends platforming with first-person puzzles.
descripcion_larga: Players explore a massive interconnected world (hide-and-seek style) using tools like hammers and glasses to find hidden paths and rescue their friends.

objetivo: Rescue all the Goonies from the Fratelli hideout to reach the end.
descripcion_corta: The iconic first game, famous for its music and secret-filled levels.
descripcion_larga: Players control Mikey, kicking enemies and placing bombs to open doors. Despite being a huge hit on the Famicom, it only saw a limited release in the West via PlayChoice-10.

objetivo: Connect pipe segments to ensure the oil flows across the screen.
descripcion_corta: A unique "Tetris-style" puzzle game featuring Mikhail Gorbachev.
descripcion_larga: Developed by Compile, players must align pipe pieces falling from the top. It was a rare example of a Japanese game featuring a prominent Soviet political figure as a friendly character.

nombre: Gorby no Pipeline Daisakusen (Japan) [En by DvD Rev A] (~Gorby's Pipeline - Great Military Operation)
objetivo: Connect pipe segments with full English translated menus.
descripcion_corta: The English version of the quirky Compile puzzle game.
descripcion_larga: This translation clarifies the scoring and mechanics of the pipeline connection, making this fast-paced and unusual puzzle title easy to master for Western fans.

objetivo: Explore various stages and defeat enemies to progress the story.
descripcion_corta: A quirky action-adventure based on a Japanese manga.
descripcion_larga: Known for its strange humor and unique character designs, players navigate through levels that blend traditional platforming with the surreal tone of the source material.

objetivo: Capture the enemy flag and shoot opponents in a paintball match.
descripcion_corta: A tactical NES Zapper game based on the paintball craze.
descripcion_larga: Using both the Zapper and the controller, players must navigate through various environments (woods, urban zones), aiming accurately to tag opponents while avoiding being hit.

objetivo: Travel across Edo-period Japan in a comedic journey.
descripcion_corta: A humorous digital board game adventure based on Japanese literature.
descripcion_larga: Players move along a map, encountering various events and mini-games that focus on the comedic mishaps of the two main characters, Yaji and Kita.

objetivo: Fly the Vic Viper and destroy the Bacterion empire.
descripcion_corta: A fan-made conversion of the MSX version of Gradius for the NES.
descripcion_larga: This version brings specific levels and mechanics from the MSX hardware (like the Bone planet) to the NES, offering a unique "alternate" take on the classic shooter.

objetivo: Defeat the Bacterion forces in this promotional special version.
descripcion_corta: A rare promotional edition of Gradius released in Japan.
descripcion_larga: Distributed as a prize by a food company, this version is functionally similar to the original but is highly sought after by collectors for its historical context.

objetivo: Fly through alien worlds and use the power-up bar to upgrade.
descripcion_corta: The definitive NES port of the legendary Konami arcade shooter.
descripcion_larga: Known for its iconic power-up system (Speed Up, Missile, Laser, Options), it set the standard for the genre and introduced the famous Konami Code.

objetivo: Fly through alien worlds and use the power-up bar to upgrade.
descripcion_corta: The original Famicom release of the legendary "Nemesis" series.
descripcion_larga: A pixel-perfect home version that captured the arcade's intensity, featuring memorable bosses like the Big Core and the iconic Moai heads.

objetivo: Fly through alien worlds and use the power-up bar to upgrade.
descripcion_corta: The definitive NES port of the legendary Konami arcade shooter.
descripcion_larga: Known for its iconic power-up system (Speed Up, Missile, Laser, Options), it set the standard for the genre and introduced the famous Konami Code.

objetivo: Lead the Vic Viper through even more dangerous alien zones.
descripcion_corta: A stunning Famicom sequel featuring the custom VRC4 chip.
descripcion_larga: One of the most impressive technical feats on the system, Gradius II features massive bosses, improved graphics, and the ability to choose different power-up loadouts.

objetivo: Survive new waves of enemies in this fan-enhanced edition.
descripcion_corta: A high-quality hack that adds content and fixes to the Gradius engine.
descripcion_larga: This version features new levels and improved color palettes, breathing new life into the classic 8-bit shooter with modern design sensibilities.

objetivo: Battle through fantasy realms to defeat the dark lord.
descripcion_corta: A fast-paced and visually impressive action game by Varie.
descripcion_larga: Featuring huge sprites and intense boss battles, Grand Master allows players to switch between different weapons and magic to adapt to the challenging fantasy enemies.

objetivo: Use different SD (Super Deformed) heroes to stop a global threat.
descripcion_corta: A crossover action game featuring Ultraman, Kamen Rider, and Gundam.
descripcion_larga: Players can switch between three iconic Japanese heroes, each with unique abilities, to navigate stages and defeat enemies in this charming 8-bit brawler.

objetivo: Train your boxer and win the professional championship belt.
descripcion_corta: A technical boxing simulation with a heavy focus on training.
descripcion_larga: Developed by Vic Tokai, this title requires players to manage their boxer's stats through training mini-games before entering the ring for strategic 8-bit bouts.

objetivo: Match card values and suits to clear the board and score points.
descripcion_corta: A refined and strategic card-based puzzle game for the Famicom.
descripcion_larga: Blending elements of Poker and Solitaire, it challenges players to think ahead and create winning combinations under time pressure to progress.

objetivo: Drive your heavy tank through enemy lines to destroy the headquarters.
descripcion_corta: The original Japanese version of the cult classic "Iron Tank."
descripcion_larga: Developed by SNK, it features non-linear paths and a wide variety of weapon upgrades, allowing players to choose how they approach the massive warzone.

objetivo: Find Waldo and specific items in crowded, colorful illustrations.
descripcion_corta: An 8-bit adaptation of the famous "Where's Waldo?" books.
descripcion_larga: Players move a cursor over large scrolling maps based on different historical or fantasy themes, testing their observation skills against the clock.

objetivo: Match tiles to dismantle the "Great Wall" in this 8-bit puzzler.
descripcion_corta: An unlicensed puzzle game by Sachen with a Mahjong-style theme.
descripcion_larga: Featuring classic tile-matching mechanics, players must strategically remove pieces from a large wall without getting stuck, aiming for the highest score.

objetivo: Master the greens across the USA with the "Great White Shark."
descripcion_corta: A technical golf game featuring unique terrain-mapping technology.
descripcion_larga: This title stands out for its "TrueView" system, allowing players to survey the course from different angles, and for including real-world course data.

objetivo: Guide Gizmo through the Clamp Center to stop the Gremlin invasion.
descripcion_corta: A gorgeous Sunsoft production with top-tier music and graphics.
descripcion_larga: Known as one of the best-looking games on the system, it features tight controls and creative gadgets that Gizmo uses to navigate through the hazards of the skyscraper.

objetivo: Guide Gizmo through the Clamp Center to stop the Gremlin invasion.
descripcion_corta: A gorgeous Sunsoft production with top-tier music and graphics.
descripcion_larga: Known as one of the best-looking games on the system, it features tight controls and creative gadgets that Gizmo uses to navigate through the hazards of the skyscraper.

objetivo: Guide Gizmo through the Clamp Center to stop the Gremlin invasion.
descripcion_corta: A gorgeous Sunsoft production with top-tier music and graphics.
descripcion_larga: Known as one of the best-looking games on the system, it features tight controls and creative gadgets that Gizmo uses to navigate through the hazards of the skyscraper.

objetivo: Infiltrate the alien base and destroy the Red Falcon core.
descripcion_corta: The original Japanese version of the legendary "Contra."
descripcion_larga: This version is superior to the US release due to the custom Konami VRC2 chip, which adds animated backgrounds (trees, snow) and story cutscenes between levels.

nombre: Gryzor (Japan) [En by MadHacker v1.0] [Fix by g8z et al] (Contra Version)
objetivo: Experience the enhanced Japanese version with full English text.
descripcion_corta: The definitive way to play Contra on the NES in English.
descripcion_larga: This fan translation brings the superior graphics and cutscenes of the Japanese Gryzor to Western players while keeping the iconic "Contra" title and feel.

nombre: Gryzor (Japan) [En by MadHacker v1.0] [Fix by g8z et al] (Gryzor Version)
objetivo: Experience the enhanced Japanese version with its original title.
descripcion_corta: A fan translation that maintains the "Gryzor" branding and story.
descripcion_larga: Like the Contra version, it features the animated backgrounds and cutscenes missing from the US release, but keeps the European/Japanese naming convention.

objetivo: Explore a massive world to activate ten safety keys and save Earth.
descripcion_corta: A brilliant hybrid of "Zelda-style" exploration and "shmup" action.
descripcion_larga: Players control a transformer that explores a world on foot and turns into a starfighter for boss battles. It is highly regarded for its deep upgrades and music.

objetivo: Explore a massive world to activate ten safety keys and save Earth.
descripcion_corta: A brilliant hybrid of "Zelda-style" exploration and "shmup" action.
descripcion_larga: Players control a transformer that explores a world on foot and turns into a starfighter for boss battles. It is highly regarded for its deep upgrades and music.

objetivo: Explore a massive world to activate ten safety keys and save Earth.
descripcion_corta: The original Japanese version of "The Guardian Legend."
descripcion_larga: Featuring the same incredible mix of exploration and intense vertical shooting, it is a cult classic that showcases the best of 8-bit hybrid design.

objetivo: Lead a revolution to overthrow a dictator in a tropical nation.
descripcion_corta: An intense and fast-paced SNK shooter with unlimited continues.
descripcion_larga: Based on the story of Che Guevara and Fidel Castro, the game features non-stop action, tank segments, and a high level of destruction throughout its levels.

objetivo: Overthrow a cruel dictator and liberate the island nation.
descripcion_corta: An intense and fast-paced SNK shooter with non-stop action.
descripcion_larga: Known for its infinite continues and heavy firepower, players fight through jungles and cities, rescuing hostages and destroying tanks in this classic arcade port.

objetivo: Lead the revolution as Che Guevara to liberate the island.
descripcion_corta: The original Japanese version of "Guerrilla War."
descripcion_larga: Unlike the Western version, this one explicitly names the protagonists Che Guevara and Fidel Castro, staying true to its historical (though stylized) revolutionary theme.

objetivo: Help Mr. Stevenson jump and avoid obstacles by shooting him.
descripcion_corta: A unique NES Zapper game that combines platforming and shooting.
descripcion_larga: Instead of shooting enemies, you shoot the protagonist to make him jump over pits and obstacles, requiring a mix of rhythm and precise aim.

objetivo: Destroy the enemy fleet and save humanity from a mechanical threat.
descripcion_corta: A fast-paced shooter based on the Japanese sci-fi film.
descripcion_larga: Known for its incredible speed and variety of power-ups, Gun Hed (also known as Blazing Lazers on other systems) is a technical marvel on the Famicom.

objetivo: Defeat the bizarre galactic army of mutated objects.
descripcion_corta: Widely considered the best vertical shooter on the NES/Famicom.
descripcion_larga: Developed by Compile, it features insane weapon variety, shops to buy upgrades, and a level of polish that pushed the NES hardware to its absolute limit.

objetivo: Defeat the bizarre galactic army of mutated objects.
descripcion_corta: Widely considered the best vertical shooter on the NES.
descripcion_larga: A masterclass in 8-bit game design, offering lightning-fast action without slowdown, customizable weapons, and some of the most creative boss fights on the system.

objetivo: Infiltrate enemy territory and take down a criminal organization.
descripcion_corta: The original Japanese version of "Laser Invasion."
descripcion_larga: Developed by Konami, it supports the Zapper and features first-person shooting segments combined with strategic helicopter flight sequences.

objetivo: Chase down criminals and uncover a dark conspiracy in the city.
descripcion_corta: The original Japanese version of "Vice: Project Doom."
descripcion_larga: An incredible hybrid game that features high-speed driving levels, first-person shooting, and top-tier ninja-style platforming action.

objetivo: Collect bounties by defeating the most dangerous outlaws in the West.
descripcion_corta: A brilliant Capcom arcade port set in the Wild West.
descripcion_larga: Unique for its control scheme where you use three buttons to shoot in different directions, players must upgrade their horse and weapons to survive.

objetivo: Collect bounties by defeating the most dangerous outlaws in the West.
descripcion_corta: A brilliant Capcom arcade port set in the Wild West.
descripcion_larga: Players control Billy Bob through desert towns and canyons, fighting through waves of bandits to confront legendary bosses in high-stakes duels.

objetivo: Pilot an advanced helicopter and destroy enemy sea and air forces.
descripcion_corta: An early Taito shooter focusing on tactical helicopter combat.
descripcion_larga: Players must manage two types of fire: forward-facing cannons for air targets and a movable crosshair for ground and sea installations.

objetivo: Help Professor Hector collect dynamite while avoiding Smicks.
descripcion_corta: One of the two games designed for use with the R.O.B. robot.
descripcion_larga: Players (or the robot) must press buttons to move red and blue pillars, creating paths for the Professor in this slow-paced but strategic puzzle game.

objetivo: Travel through the solar system to reach Earth while destroying aliens.
descripcion_corta: A unique 360-degree shooter that blends Galaga and Tempest.
descripcion_larga: Developed by Konami, this NES version adds power-ups and epic boss battles at each planet, all set to an iconic 8-bit Bach-inspired soundtrack.

objetivo: Travel the land to find the four heroes and defeat the demon king.
descripcion_corta: An early and complex RPG with an emphasis on exploration.
descripcion_larga: Known as "The Seal of the Dragon," it features a massive world map and a unique combat system where positioning and party management are key to survival.

objetivo: Use your giant hammer to fight through construction sites and cities.
descripcion_corta: A charming and difficult action game by Irem.
descripcion_larga: As Harry, players must smash enemies and projectiles to stop a corrupt construction company. It features great humor, big sprites, and tough boss fights.

objetivo: Guide a young couple through the music industry to become stars.
descripcion_corta: A quirky and notoriously difficult game about the road to fame.
descripcion_larga: Players control two characters simultaneously, navigating through various stages filled with hazards that represent the struggles of a pop music career.

objetivo: Defeat opponents in the traditional Japanese card game Hanafuda.
descripcion_corta: An unlicensed and more "mature" take on the classic Hanafuda game.
descripcion_larga: Featuring high-quality 8-bit art, this title offers various modes and opponents to challenge your mastery of the "Flower Cards" rules.

objetivo: Defend your castle and conquer others using "Egg" monsters.
descripcion_corta: A humorous and innovative RTS game developed by Square.
descripcion_larga: Players manage a kingdom and summon monsters from eggs to fight battles. It’s famous for its parody of RPG tropes and its slapstick humor.

objetivo: Collect items and avoid hazards to reach Bugs' birthday party.
descripcion_corta: Known in the West as "The Bugs Bunny Birthday Blowout."
descripcion_larga: Bugs uses a mallet to defeat enemies through colorful levels based on classic Looney Tunes shorts, featuring guest appearances from the whole cast.

objetivo: Complete the stunt course and beat the clock in 3D perspective.
descripcion_corta: A fascinating prototype of the ambitious 3D arcade racer.
descripcion_larga: This unreleased port attempted to recreate the arcade's polygons using the NES's limited hardware, offering a glimpse into early 3D console experimentation.

objetivo: Perform tricks and win games in this comedic basketball sim.
descripcion_corta: A licensed game featuring the world-famous trick basketball team.
descripcion_larga: Players can perform signature Globetrotters moves and mini-games, blending traditional basketball gameplay with the team's iconic entertainment style.

objetivo: Navigate through fantasy stages using magical powers.
descripcion_corta: An unlicensed Chinese action game featuring a "Harry Potter" theme.
descripcion_larga: This bootleg attempts to bring the magic of the boy wizard to the NES, featuring unique sprites and spell-based combat in various themed levels.

objetivo: Navigate through fantasy stages using magical powers in English.
descripcion_corta: The English-translated version of the Chinese Harry Potter bootleg.
descripcion_larga: This translation makes the menus and simple story of the unlicensed action game accessible to English-speaking collectors and players.

objetivo: Manage your farm, grow crops, and raise animals in 8-bit form.
descripcion_corta: An unlicensed Chinese "demake" of the famous farming series.
descripcion_larga: This bootleg attempts to shrink the SNES/Game Boy experience onto the NES, featuring basic farming mechanics and town interaction in a simplified format.

objetivo: Stack five identical hats to clear them from the screen.
descripcion_corta: A quirky puzzle game designed by the creator of Tetris.
descripcion_larga: Instead of blocks, players manage different types of hats (crowns, top hats, etc.). It requires strategic stacking to prevent the piles from reaching the top of the shop.

objetivo: Stack five identical hats to clear them from the screen.
descripcion_corta: The Western release of Alexey Pajitnov's hat-stacking puzzler.
descripcion_larga: Featuring the same addictive gameplay as the Japanese version, it challenges players to master the unique physics and sorting logic of 8-bit millinery.

objetivo: Defeat opponents in the traditional game of Go (Igo).
descripcion_corta: A fast-paced digital version of the classic Eastern board game.
descripcion_larga: Featuring a specialized AI for quick decision-making, it allows players to practice and compete in Go matches with various difficulty settings on the Famicom.

objetivo: Infiltrate the base and assemble the "Heavy Barrel" super weapon.
descripcion_corta: An intense Data East arcade port with 360-degree shooting.
descripcion_larga: Players fight through waves of enemies to find keys for red lockers containing pieces of a devastating energy cannon, using it to clear the most difficult bosses.

objetivo: Infiltrate the base and assemble the "Heavy Barrel" super weapon.
descripcion_corta: A high-action military shooter known for its powerful upgrades.
descripcion_larga: Similar to "Ikari Warriors" but with smoother gameplay, it features diverse environments and a heavy emphasis on collecting weapon parts to gain temporary invincibility.

objetivo: Navigate dangerous downhill slopes and perform tricks to finish.
descripcion_corta: One of the few dedicated snowboarding games on the NES.
descripcion_larga: Players must manage speed and balance across various terrain types, from powdery snow to icy peaks, avoiding obstacles in a race against the clock.

objetivo: Explore a surreal world and find your friends to escape.
descripcion_corta: A cult classic "Metroidvania" known as "Ufouria" in the West.
descripcion_larga: Featuring a bizarre and charming art style, players switch between four unique characters (a penguin, a cat-ghost, etc.) to use their specific abilities to reach new areas.

objetivo: Destroy the biological and mechanical invaders across time.
descripcion_corta: A high-difficulty shooter known in the West as "Starship Hector."
descripcion_larga: Developed by Hudson Soft, it alternates between vertical and horizontal scrolling stages, requiring players to master both ground and air-based attacks.

objetivo: Help Bakabon's Papa navigate through chaotic and surreal levels.
descripcion_corta: A humorous action game based on the famous comedy manga.
descripcion_larga: Players use an umbrella as a weapon and tool to navigate strange environments, capturing the absurd and slapstick humor of the legendary Fujio Akatsuka series.

nombre: Heisei Tensai Bakabon (Japan) [En by KingMike v1.0] (~Genius Bakabon, The)
objetivo: Navigate surreal levels with fully translated comedic dialogue.
descripcion_corta: The English fan translation of the wacky Famicom action title.
descripcion_larga: This version makes the absurd jokes and level objectives clear, allowing Western fans to enjoy one of Japan's most iconic comedy franchises in 8-bit.

objetivo: Pilot a combat aircraft and destroy waves of demonic enemies.
descripcion_corta: An unlicensed military shooter with a dark, intense theme.
descripcion_larga: Developed by Sachen, it features relentless enemy patterns and a variety of power-ups, challenging players to survive a "hellish" battlefield from start to finish.

objetivo: Water all the flowers in each garden while avoiding enemies.
descripcion_corta: A cute and colorful puzzle-platformer featuring Hello Kitty.
descripcion_larga: Kitty must navigate through platforms to reach flower beds, using her watering can and avoiding moles and bees in a family-friendly 8-bit adventure.

nombre: Hello Kitty no Ohanabatake (Japan) [En by Suicidal v1.0] (~Hello Kitty's Flower Shop)
objetivo: Tend to your flower shop gardens with translated menus.
descripcion_corta: The English fan translation of Kitty's floral puzzle adventure.
descripcion_larga: This version makes the level instructions and cute story segments accessible, perfect for younger players or Sanrio fans using the original hardware.

objetivo: Navigate through themed worlds using a magical balloon.
descripcion_corta: A Hello Kitty-themed remake of the game "Balloon Kid."
descripcion_larga: Players must tap buttons to flap their balloons and stay airborne, navigating through obstacles and collecting items in this charming 8-bit platformer.

nombre: Hello Kitty World (Japan) [En by Flake v1.0]
objetivo: Navigate themed worlds with translated English text.
descripcion_corta: An English fan translation for the balloon-based adventure.
descripcion_larga: This patch replaces the Japanese text, making the world names and simple story accessible to English-speaking fans of the Sanrio mascot.

nombre: Hello Kitty World (Japan) [En by HK Kicks Ass v1.0]
objetivo: Navigate themed worlds with a more "edgy" fan translation.
descripcion_corta: An alternative English translation with a humorous/rough tone.
descripcion_larga: A community-made translation that adds a bit of 90s-style "attitude" to the text of the otherwise innocent Hello Kitty game.

nombre: Herakles no Eikou - Toujin Makyou Den (Japan)
objetivo: Journey across ancient Greece to defeat the God of Hades.
descripcion_corta: The first entry in the "Glory of Heracles" mythological series.
descripcion_larga: Inspired by Dragon Quest, it features a heavy focus on Greek myths, challenging players to gather legendary items and talk to gods to complete their quest.

nombre: Herakles no Eikou 2 - Titan no Metsubou (Japan)
objetivo: Stop the resurrection of the Titans and save the world.
descripcion_corta: A vastly improved sequel with deeper mechanics and story.
descripcion_larga: Featuring a more advanced combat system and a moving narrative, it is considered one of the most underrated RPG gems on the Famicom.

nombre: Herakles no Eikou 2 - Titan no Metsubou (Japan) [En by Spoony Bard v1.31] (~Glory of Heracles 2, The - Titans' Downfall)
objetivo: Stop the Titans with full English translated lore and menus.
descripcion_corta: The high-quality fan translation of the second Herakles title.
descripcion_larga: This translation allows Western players to fully enjoy the epic mythological story and the improved 8-bit RPG mechanics of the Data East classic.

objetivo: Complete various dungeon quests to defeat the evil Morcar.
descripcion_corta: An unreleased prototype based on the famous board game.
descripcion_larga: A fascinating 8-bit adaptation that captures the turn-based movement and combat of the original tabletop game, featuring several different hero classes and quests.

objetivo: Defeat your opponent in the "Dark" version of Chinese Chess.
descripcion_corta: An unlicensed digital version of An Qi (Hidden Chess).
descripcion_larga: Played on a half-board with face-down pieces, this game focuses on luck and strategy as pieces are revealed and captured in a unique tactical loop.

nombre: Higemaru Makaijima - Nanatsu no Shima Daibouken (Japan)
objetivo: Explore seven islands to find the hidden treasure of the pirates.
descripcion_corta: An expansive adventure based on the "Higemaru" arcade game.
descripcion_larga: Developed by Capcom, players throw barrels at enemies to clear paths. It features a non-linear map where players must sail between islands to find keys and bosses.

nombre: Higemaru Makaijima - Nanatsu no Shima Daibouken (Japan) [En by Snark v1.0] (~Seven Islands Adventure)
objetivo: Explore the islands and find pirate treasure in English.
descripcion_corta: The English fan translation of Capcom's high-seas adventure.
descripcion_larga: This translation makes the clues given by NPCs and the names of the islands clear, which is essential for solving the game's many navigational puzzles.

objetivo: Achieve the highest score and trigger the multi-ball police chase.
descripcion_corta: A faithful port of the classic Williams arcade pinball machine.
descripcion_larga: Known for its fast-paced action and car-chase theme, the NES version includes bonus mini-games and accurate table physics for 8-bit pinball fans.

objetivo: Achieve the highest score and trigger the multi-ball police chase.
descripcion_corta: A faithful port of the classic Williams arcade pinball machine.
descripcion_larga: Known for its fast-paced action and car-chase theme, the NES version includes bonus mini-games and accurate table physics for 8-bit pinball fans.

objetivo: Race against the clock through various stages to reach the finish line.
descripcion_corta: A high-speed racing game by Square, known as "Rad Racer" in the West.
descripcion_larga: Featuring impressive 3D-style scaling and a selectable soundtrack, it was one of the first games to offer a 3D mode using specialized anaglyph glasses.

nombre: Hinotori - Houou Hen - Gaou no Bouken (Japan)
objetivo: Collect phoenix feathers to rebuild the legendary firebird.
descripcion_corta: A Konami classic based on Osamu Tezuka's famous "Phoenix" manga.
descripcion_larga: Players control Gaou, who can create tiles to use as platforms. It features a unique branching path system and massive bosses across different historical eras.

objetivo: Complete various learning activities with the show's mascots.
descripcion_corta: An educational title based on a popular Japanese children's TV show.
descripcion_larga: Gachapin and Mukku guide children through simple logic, math, and word puzzles, designed with the colorful and friendly aesthetic of the 8-bit era.

nombre: Hirake! Ponkikki (Japan) [En by Gil Galad v1.01]
objetivo: Complete learning activities with translated instructions.
descripcion_corta: The English fan translation of the Ponkikki children's game.
descripcion_larga: This version makes the educational mini-games accessible to English speakers, allowing children to enjoy the 8-bit lessons without the language barrier.

nombre: Hirake! Ponkikki (Japan) [En by Unknown v1.0] (~Open! Ponkikki)
objetivo: Complete learning activities with translated instructions.
descripcion_corta: An alternative English translation of the Ponkikki educational title.
descripcion_larga: Similar to other versions, it translates the menus and prompts, providing a clear path through the various 8-bit learning challenges.

nombre: Hiryuu no Ken - Ougi no Sho (Japan)
objetivo: Master the dragon arts to win the world martial arts tournament.
descripcion_corta: The first entry in the series known in the West as "Flying Dragon."
descripcion_larga: It blends side-scrolling exploration with a unique "mark" system in one-on-one combat, where players must strike specific points on an opponent.

nombre: Hiryuu no Ken II - Dragon no Tsubasa (Japan)
objetivo: Defeat the Dark Wizard and his army using mystical dragon powers.
descripcion_corta: An expanded sequel with improved combat and cinematic cutscenes.
descripcion_larga: This entry introduces more specialized moves and a deeper story, following the "Flying Warriors" as they battle supernatural threats across the globe.

nombre: Hiryuu no Ken III - 5 Nin no Ryuu Senshi (Japan)
objetivo: Lead five dragon warriors to stop the ultimate evil from rising.
descripcion_corta: A multi-protagonist sequel featuring different martial arts styles.
descripcion_larga: Players can choose between five different characters, each with their own unique attacks and special skills, adding variety to the series' tactical combat.

nombre: Hiryuu no Ken Special - Fighting Wars (Japan)
objetivo: Compete in a dedicated world tournament with refined mechanics.
descripcion_corta: A special edition focusing primarily on the one-on-one fighting mode.
descripcion_larga: This version polishes the combat engine and provides a streamlined tournament experience for fans of the "Hiryu no Ken" mark-based fighting system.

objetivo: Challenge and defeat the masters of various rival dojos.
descripcion_corta: A martial arts strategy and fighting game for the Famicom.
descripcion_larga: Players must train their character and then travel to different schools, using a mix of tactical decision-making and real-time combat to prove their strength.

objetivo: Take on contracts to eliminate corrupt officials in Edo Japan.
descripcion_corta: A stealth-based action game based on a popular period drama.
descripcion_larga: Players control different "executioners" who use unique tools to navigate levels and assassinate targets, blending story adventure with strategic combat.

objetivo: Hit as many marmots as possible before the time runs out.
descripcion_corta: An unlicensed 8-bit recreation of the classic "Whack-a-Mole" arcade game.
descripcion_larga: Simple and fast-paced, it tests the player's reflexes as they try to clear the screen of moles while avoiding penalties in this colorful bootleg.

nombre: Hit the Ice - VHL the Video Hockey League (USA) (Proto)
objetivo: Win the VHL championship in this aggressive arcade-style hockey game.
descripcion_corta: An unreleased NES prototype of the famous comedic hockey hit.
descripcion_larga: Known for its large sprites and violent "power shots," this version offers a look at how the arcade's slapstick hockey was being ported to the 8-bit system.

objetivo: Rescue Super Joe and stop the resurrection of an ancient leader.
descripcion_corta: The uncensored Japanese version of "Bionic Commando."
descripcion_larga: Unlike the Western release, this version contains Nazi imagery and explicit references, featuring the famous grappling hook mechanic and non-linear level choice.

objetivo: Distinguish between gangsters and civilians in a shooting range.
descripcion_corta: A classic NES Zapper game that tests speed and judgment.
descripcion_larga: Players must shoot target cutouts of criminals while sparing innocent bystanders, featuring several modes including a "trick shot" game involving tin cans.

nombre: Hokkaidou Rensa Satsujin - Okhotsk ni Kiyu (Japan)
objetivo: Solve a series of linked murders across the Hokkaido region.
descripcion_corta: A pioneering menu-driven detective adventure by Yuji Horii.
descripcion_larga: As a police detective, you must investigate crime scenes and interview suspects. It is famous for its mature story and for being a precursor to the visual novel genre.

objetivo: Navigate the wasteland and defeat Shin to rescue Yuria.
