descripcion_corta: The Japanese version of the first "Fist of the North Star" game.
descripcion_larga: As Kenshiro, players use deadly pressure-point attacks to make enemies explode, featuring challenging platforming and iconic 8-bit martial arts action.

nombre: Hokuto no Ken (Japan) [En by Stardust Crusaders v1.0] (~Fist of the North Star)
objetivo: Navigate the wasteland with fully translated dialogue and menus.
descripcion_corta: An English fan translation that restores the original anime context.
descripcion_larga: This version uses the original Japanese names and lore, providing a more authentic experience for fans of the legendary anime and manga series.

nombre: Hokuto no Ken 2 - Seikimatsu Kyuuseishu Densetsu (Japan)
objetivo: Continue Kenshiro's journey against the celestial emperor's forces.
descripcion_corta: A sequel featuring larger sprites and more intense combat.
descripcion_larga: Based on the second half of the series, players fight through waves of enemies using upgraded techniques and power-ups to face the strongest rivals.

nombre: Hokuto no Ken 2 - Seikimatsu Kyuuseishu Densetsu (Japan) [En by Extreme Fun v0.50] (~Fist of the North Star 2) (Incomplete)
objetivo: Continue Kenshiro's journey with partially translated text.
descripcion_corta: An English fan translation for the second Hokuto no Ken title.
descripcion_larga: While incomplete, it makes the basic menus and story beats accessible for those wanting to play the 8-bit sequel to the "Fist of the North Star."

nombre: Hokuto no Ken 3 - Shin Seiki Souzou Seiken Restuden (Japan)
objetivo: Experience the entire Hokuto no Ken saga in a massive RPG quest.
descripcion_corta: A deep RPG that covers the story from the beginning of the series.
descripcion_larga: Unlike the previous action games, this entry features turn-based combat and party management, staying extremely faithful to the original manga's epic plot.

nombre: Hokuto no Ken 4 - Shichisei Haken Den - Hokuto Shinken no Kanata he (Japan)
objetivo: Lead a new generation of warriors in an original Hokuto story.
descripcion_corta: The final Famicom entry, featuring an original plot set after the series.
descripcion_larga: It features improved 8-bit graphics and a refined combat system, allowing players to create their own legacy in the post-apocalyptic world of the North Star.

objetivo: Get three symbols in a row by agreeing or disagreeing with celebrities.
descripcion_corta: A digital version of the popular Tic-Tac-Toe themed game show.
descripcion_larga: Players must judge if the "celebrities" in the squares are telling the truth or lying, testing both their general knowledge and their sense of human psychology.

objetivo: Defeat the black slayer and reclaim the royal family's power.
descripcion_corta: A cult classic known for its Heavy Metal aesthetic and high difficulty.
descripcion_larga: Playing as Ronnie, you use magic spells to fight through gothic levels. It is famous for its intricate sprite work and for being a love letter to 80s rock icons.

objetivo: Defeat the black slayer with fully translated story and menus.
descripcion_corta: An English fan translation of the Heavy Metal-themed action gem.
descripcion_larga: This version allows players to follow the dark fantasy plot while navigating the game's brutal platforming challenges and boss encounters.

objetivo: Hide and set traps to avoid being caught by the Wet Bandits for 20 minutes.
descripcion_corta: A game of cat and mouse based on the hit Christmas movie.
descripcion_larga: Players control Kevin McCallister, running through the mansion to collect valuables and drop traps like lightbulbs and toys to stall Harry and Marv until the police arrive.

objetivo: Hide and set traps to avoid being caught by the Wet Bandits for 20 minutes.
descripcion_corta: A revised version of the movie tie-in with minor bug fixes.
descripcion_larga: This revision addresses small glitches in character movement and trap interaction, providing a more stable experience of Kevin's solo defense of his home.

nombre: Home Alone 2 - Lost in New York (Europe)
objetivo: Evade the Wet Bandits and navigate the hazards of New York City.
descripcion_corta: The PAL version of the sequel, featuring varied city environments.
descripcion_larga: Unlike the first game, this is a more traditional platformer where Kevin uses weapons like a dart gun to fight off enemies in hotels, parks, and construction sites.

nombre: Home Alone 2 - Lost in New York (USA)
objetivo: Evade the Wet Bandits and navigate the hazards of New York City.
descripcion_corta: A challenging platformer based on Kevin's big adventure in the city.
descripcion_larga: Players must navigate through iconic movie locations like the Plaza Hotel, using various gadgets to defeat enemies and escape the persistent Harry and Marv.

objetivo: Lead your team to victory in a full baseball season.
descripcion_corta: A high-energy Famicom baseball title by Data East.
descripcion_larga: Known for its fast gameplay and detailed player stats, this game focuses on the "Pennant League" experience, offering a deep simulation of Japan's favorite sport.

nombre: Home Run Nighter '90 - The Pennant League (Japan)
objetivo: Win the championship in the updated 1990 baseball season.
descripcion_corta: An improved sequel with updated rosters and refined graphics.
descripcion_larga: This version features smoother animations and expanded tactical options for pitching and batting, representing the peak of the 8-bit Nighter series.

objetivo: Win games of Janken to progress through different stages.
descripcion_corta: An unlicensed "mature" themed puzzle game from the Asian market.
descripcion_larga: Using simple rock-paper-scissors mechanics, players compete against various opponents. It features high-quality 8-bit character art typical of unlicensed Famicom titles.

objetivo: Lead Danpei's team to the national dodgeball championship.
descripcion_corta: An intense dodgeball game based on the popular manga and anime.
descripcion_larga: Featuring special "super shots" and dramatic animations, players must manage their team's health and positioning to knock out all opponents on the court.

nombre: Honoo no Doukyuuji - Dodge Danpei (Japan) [En by TransGen v1.0b] (~Dan's Dodge Ball)
objetivo: Win the dodgeball championship with fully translated menus.
descripcion_corta: The English fan translation of the first Dodge Danpei game.
descripcion_larga: This version makes the team management and special move names accessible, allowing Western fans to enjoy the over-the-top 8-bit sports action.

objetivo: Conquer the international dodgeball tournament with Danpei.
descripcion_corta: An improved sequel featuring bigger sprites and more special moves.
descripcion_larga: This entry expands the roster and adds more complex team strategies, making the dodgeball matches even more fast-paced and cinematic than the original.

nombre: Honoo no Doukyuuji - Dodge Danpei 2 (Japan) [En by TransGen v1.0a] (~Dan's Dodge Ball 2)
objetivo: Win the international tournament with translated text.
descripcion_corta: The English fan translation of the second Dodge Danpei title.
descripcion_larga: This patch clarifies the updated mechanics and story beats, providing the definitive way to experience Danpei's second quest for dodgeball glory.

objetivo: Defeat high-ranking AI opponents in traditional Japanese chess.
descripcion_corta: A professional-grade Shogi simulator endorsed by Master Naitou.
descripcion_larga: Featuring deep AI routines and various handicap settings, this title is designed for serious students of Shogi looking for a challenge on the Famicom.

objetivo: Rescue Peter Pan's children from the clutches of Captain Hook.
descripcion_corta: A high-quality platformer based on the Spielberg fantasy film.
descripcion_larga: As Peter Pan, players fly, swim, and fight through Neverland. The game is praised for its beautiful 8-bit graphics and faithful recreation of the movie's atmosphere.

objetivo: Rescue Peter Pan's children from the clutches of Captain Hook.
descripcion_corta: The Famicom version of the cinematic Hook adventure.
descripcion_larga: Featuring the same polished gameplay as the Western releases, it showcases some of the best visual effects and animations available on the 8-bit hardware.

objetivo: Rescue Peter Pan's children from the clutches of Captain Hook.
descripcion_corta: A polished movie-licensed platformer with great music and visuals.
descripcion_larga: Players explore forest and pirate ship levels, using a dagger and magical flight to overcome obstacles and confront the legendary Captain Hook.

objetivo: Win the street basketball tournament in 1-on-1 or 2-on-2 matches.
descripcion_corta: A gritty urban basketball game focusing on half-court play.
descripcion_larga: Known as "Moero!! Junior Basket" in Japan, it features large character sprites and allows for a more aggressive, arcade-style take on the sport.

objetivo: Win the street basketball tournament in 1-on-1 or 2-on-2 matches.
descripcion_corta: A gritty urban basketball game focusing on half-court play.
descripcion_larga: Players can choose from different fictional neighborhoods and players, each with unique stats, in this fast-paced 8-bit streetball simulation.

nombre: Hoshi no Kirby - Yume no Izumi no Monogatari (Japan)
objetivo: Recover the Star Rod and restore dreams to Dream Land.
descripcion_corta: One of the most technically advanced and beloved games on the NES.
descripcion_larga: Known as "Kirby's Adventure," it introduced Kirby's ability to copy enemy powers. It features incredible graphics, massive levels, and a battery-backed save system.

objetivo: Lead a group of psychics to uncover the truth about a dying world.
descripcion_corta: A notoriously difficult and surreal post-apocalyptic RPG.
descripcion_larga: Famous for its strange mechanics, lack of guidance, and unique sci-fi atmosphere, it has gained a cult following as one of the most "challenging" Famicom games.

nombre: Hoshi wo Miru Hito (Japan) [En by KingMike v0.80] (~Stargazers) (Incomplete)
objetivo: Lead the psychics through the dying world with translated text.
descripcion_corta: An English fan translation for the cult classic Hoshi wo Miru Hito.
descripcion_larga: While the game remains difficult, this translation helps clarify the cryptic dialogue and menus of this very unusual 8-bit role-playing experience.

nombre: Hoshi wo Miru Hito (Japan) [En by KingMike v0.80] (~Stargazers) (SRAM Saving) (Incomplete)
objetivo: Lead a group of psychics in a dying world with save support.
descripcion_corta: The fan-translated version of Hoshi wo Miru Hito with a save fix.
descripcion_larga: This version adds SRAM support to the notorious RPG, allowing players to save their progress properly, making the brutal journey through the psychic wasteland more manageable.

objetivo: Infiltrate the embassy, eliminate terrorists, and rescue the hostages.
descripcion_corta: A tactical simulation known as "Rescue: The Embassy Mission."
descripcion_larga: Players control a team of snipers and a dynamic assault squad. It features multiple phases, from positioning snipers to rappelling down walls and clearing rooms in first-person.

objetivo: Win big on various themed slot machines to unlock rewards.
descripcion_corta: An unlicensed adult-themed casino game for the NES.
descripcion_larga: Featuring high-quality 8-bit character art for its time, this game simulates various slot machines with different themes, focusing on the luck of the draw to gain credits.

objetivo: Unify Japan during the Sengoku period through military conquest.
descripcion_corta: A deep historical war simulation based on a popular manga.
descripcion_larga: Players manage resources, troop placements, and diplomacy. It’s known for its detailed maps and strategic depth, typical of late-Famicom historical sims.

objetivo: Dig through the earth to find lava-cooling items and save the world.
descripcion_corta: A digging adventure game similar to "Dig Dug" but with more exploration.
descripcion_larga: As Hottarman, you navigate underground mazes, managing your air supply while using drills and bombs to clear paths and defeat subterranean enemies.

nombre: Hottarman no Chitei Tanken (Japan) [En by Six Feet Under v1.0] (~Hotman)
objetivo: Dig through the earth to save the world with translated text.
descripcion_corta: The English fan translation of the digging adventure "Hottarman."
descripcion_larga: This translation makes the mission objectives and item descriptions clear, allowing players to focus on the strategic digging and survival mechanics of the game.

objetivo: Defeat mythological Japanese demons in a dark fantasy setting.
descripcion_corta: A challenging platformer featuring traditional Japanese Yokai.
descripcion_larga: Players navigate through atmospheric levels based on folklore, using various weapons and magic to cleanse the land of evil spirits and powerful bosses.

objetivo: Lead the legendary Yellow Emperor on a quest to unify ancient China.
descripcion_corta: An unlicensed Chinese RPG with a heavy focus on mythology.
descripcion_larga: Featuring large sprites and a complex world map, this bootleg title attempts to bring the scale of 16-bit RPGs to the Famicom hardware.

objetivo: Infiltrate high-security buildings to steal three Da Vinci artifacts.
descripcion_corta: A creative action game based on the Bruce Willis film.
descripcion_larga: Players must use stealth, timing, and various gadgets to bypass guards and complex security systems, emphasizing clever movement over brute force.

objetivo: Infiltrate high-security buildings to steal three Da Vinci artifacts.
descripcion_corta: The Japanese release of the movie-inspired heist game.
descripcion_larga: Featuring the same polished mechanics as the Western versions, this Famicom title captures the quirky tone and puzzle-like platforming of the "Hudson Hawk" film.

objetivo: Infiltrate high-security buildings to steal three Da Vinci artifacts.
descripcion_corta: A creative action game based on the Bruce Willis film.
descripcion_larga: Players must use stealth, timing, and various gadgets to bypass guards and complex security systems, emphasizing clever movement over brute force.

nombre: Hudson's Adventure Island - Classic in the Pacific (Europe)
objetivo: Rescue Princess Leilani by surviving various tropical islands.
descripcion_corta: A compilation or specific PAL release of the foundational platformer.
descripcion_larga: Master Higgins must constantly eat fruit to maintain his stamina while riding skateboards and throwing stone axes to defeat island creatures.

objetivo: Rescue Princess Leilani by surviving various tropical islands.
descripcion_corta: The legendary NES port of "Wonder Boy," featuring Master Higgins.
descripcion_larga: Known for its catchy music and high difficulty, this game became a staple of the NES library, emphasizing momentum and fast-paced platforming.

objetivo: Save Higgins' girlfriend from the evil witch doctor.
descripcion_corta: An improved sequel that introduces dinosaur companions.
descripcion_larga: Players can now ride four different dinosaurs, each with unique abilities (fire, flight, etc.), and store items in an inventory between levels.

objetivo: Rescue Higgins' girlfriend from alien invaders.
descripcion_corta: The most refined entry in the series, featuring expanded dinosaur mechanics.
descripcion_larga: Higgins can now crouch, and the dinosaur roster is expanded. It features a larger world map and a non-linear feel compared to the previous entries.

nombre: Hudson's Adventure Island III (USA) [Hack by Aether Knight v1.0] (~Adventure Island 3 - The Lost Isles)
objetivo: Navigate an entirely new set of islands with increased difficulty.
descripcion_corta: A high-quality level-hack that provides new challenges for AI3 veterans.
descripcion_larga: This version features completely redesigned stages and harder enemy placements, breathing fresh life into the Adventure Island III engine.

objetivo: Save Higgins' girlfriend with the help of your dinosaur friends.
descripcion_corta: The European PAL release of the second Adventure Island adventure.
descripcion_larga: Featuring the same dinosaur-riding mechanics and inventory system, it offers a more balanced and accessible experience than the original title.

objetivo: Pilot a starship to destroy swarms of giant mechanical insects.
descripcion_corta: An unlicensed space shooter by Sachen with a bug theme.
descripcion_larga: Players face waves of arthropod-themed enemies and bosses, using a variety of weapon power-ups in a fast-paced arcade-style combat loop.

objetivo: Guide the Red October to the US while avoiding Soviet forces.
descripcion_corta: A tactical submarine game based on the Tom Clancy novel and film.
descripcion_larga: It blends side-scrolling navigation with tactical combat phases, where players must manage sonar, torpedoes, and evasion tactics to survive the journey.

objetivo: Guide the Red October to the US while avoiding Soviet forces.
descripcion_corta: A tactical submarine game based on the Tom Clancy novel and film.
descripcion_larga: It blends side-scrolling navigation with tactical combat phases, where players must manage sonar, torpedoes, and evasion tactics to survive the journey.

nombre: Hunt for Red October, The (USA) (Rev A)
objetivo: Guide the Red October to the US with minor technical fixes.
descripcion_corta: A revised version of the submarine simulation with bug fixes.
descripcion_larga: This revision addresses small glitches in sonar detection and level transitions, ensuring a smoother tactical experience for the player.

objetivo: Lead a parade of spirits through the night to conquer territory.
descripcion_corta: A unique strategy game based on the "Night Parade of One Hundred Demons."
descripcion_larga: Players move Yokai across a map, engaging in tactical battles and random events based on Japanese folklore, all presented with traditional 8-bit art.

nombre: Hyaku no Sekai no Monogatari - The Tales on a Watery Wilderness (Japan)
objetivo: Journey through a fantasy world and reach the goal first.
descripcion_corta: A charming hybrid of a digital board game and a turn-based RPG.
descripcion_larga: Up to four players can compete, moving across tiles that trigger battles, item finds, or story events, creating a "party game" RPG experience.

nombre: Hyaku no Sekai no Monogatari - The Tales on a Watery Wilderness (Japan) [En by AlanMidas v20070425] (~100 World Story, The)
objetivo: Journey through the fantasy world with full English text.
descripcion_corta: The English fan translation of the unique RPG-board game hybrid.
descripcion_larga: This translation is essential for understanding the many random events, item effects, and humorous dialogue that occur as players race across the world map.

objetivo: Find the three jewels and defeat the demon Varalys to save Fairyland.
descripcion_corta: An early and influential (though controversial) action RPG.
descripcion_larga: Known for its "bump" combat system, Hydlide requires players to manage health and level up by attacking enemies. It's a foundational title for the ARPG genre.

objetivo: Stop the darkness from consuming the land in this advanced sequel.
descripcion_corta: A much more complex RPG featuring a weight system and day/night cycles.
descripcion_larga: Hydlide 3 introduced "modern" RPG elements like hunger and a morality system, pushing the Famicom hardware with its deep mechanical systems.

objetivo: Save Fairyland in this enhanced Famicom version of the original game.
descripcion_corta: An updated version of Hydlide featuring improved graphics and sound.
descripcion_larga: This version polishes the original 1984 PC-88 release for the Famicom, offering smoother gameplay and a more vibrant visual palette.

nombre: Hyokkori Hyoutan Jima - Nazo no Kaizokusen (Japan)
objetivo: Solve the mystery of the pirate ship to protect the floating island.
descripcion_corta: An adventure game based on a famous Japanese puppet show.
descripcion_larga: Players explore the island and talk to quirky characters to gather clues and items, solving spatial puzzles to progress the charming narrative.

objetivo: Win gold in various Olympic events in this limited "Prize" edition.
descripcion_corta: A rare promotional version of Hyper Olympic for the Famicom.
descripcion_larga: Features the same classic button-mashing gameplay as the original, but holds historical value as a special distribution for Japanese fans.

objetivo: Compete in track and field events to achieve world records.
descripcion_corta: The foundational button-mashing sports game (Track & Field).
descripcion_larga: Players must press buttons rapidly to run and time their presses for jumps and throws. It’s the quintessential 8-bit competitive sports experience.

objetivo: Master new Olympic events like swimming and skeet shooting.
descripcion_corta: The official sequel to Hyper Olympic with more varied events.
descripcion_larga: It expands the roster of sports to include archery, triple jump, and more, requiring different rhythms and timing beyond simple rapid button-mashing.

objetivo: Master new Olympic events with minor bug fixes.
descripcion_corta: A revised release of the Hyper Sports Famicom sequel.
descripcion_larga: This revision ensures better compatibility and fixes minor scoring glitches in certain events like the pole vault or swimming.

objetivo: Lead your female softball team to the national championship.
descripcion_corta: A unique 8-bit sports title focusing on softball instead of baseball.
descripcion_larga: Featuring distinct physics and a female roster, this game offers a fresh take on the ball-and-bat genre with colorful sprites and fast-paced arcade gameplay.

objetivo: Rescue the Smurfs from Gargamel's castle as a brave Smurf.
descripcion_corta: An Italian-language release of "The Smurfs" platformer.
descripcion_larga: Based on the Peyo cartoons, it features impressive 8-bit visuals for a late-release title, challenging players to navigate forests and swamps to reach Gargamel's lair.

objetivo: Scale 32 icy mountains to retrieve stolen vegetables from a giant bird.
descripcion_corta: A foundational Nintendo classic featuring Popo and Nana.
descripcion_larga: Players use hammers to break through layers of ice while avoiding seals and birds. It is famous for its cooperative play and the challenging bonus stage at the peak.

objetivo: Scale 32 icy mountains to retrieve stolen vegetables from a giant bird.
descripcion_corta: A foundational Nintendo classic featuring Popo and Nana.
descripcion_larga: Players use hammers to break through layers of ice while avoiding seals and birds. It is famous for its cooperative play and the challenging bonus stage at the peak.

objetivo: Outscore your opponent in a fast-paced international hockey match.
descripcion_corta: A beloved Nintendo sports title featuring customizable team weights.
descripcion_larga: Players can choose between thin, medium, and fat skaters, each with different speed and power stats, creating a deep layer of strategy for an 8-bit sports game.

objetivo: Outscore your opponent in a fast-paced international hockey match.
descripcion_corta: A beloved Nintendo sports title featuring customizable team weights.
descripcion_larga: Players can choose between thin, medium, and fat skaters, each with different speed and power stats, creating a deep layer of strategy for an 8-bit sports game.

nombre: Ide Yousuke Meijin no Jissen Mahjong (Japan) (Rev A)
objetivo: Defeat Mahjong masters using expert techniques and luck.
descripcion_corta: A professional Mahjong simulation endorsed by expert Yousuke Ide.
descripcion_larga: This version features refined AI and updated logic for more realistic tile-drawing, catering to serious fans of the traditional Japanese four-player game.

nombre: Ide Yousuke Meijin no Jissen Mahjong 2 (Japan)
objetivo: Climb the ranks of the Mahjong world in this expanded sequel.
descripcion_corta: An improved simulation featuring better graphics and a career mode.
descripcion_larga: It includes more detailed tutorials and strategic advice from Ide himself, making it one of the most comprehensive Mahjong titles on the Famicom.

objetivo: Help Erika become a pop star to inherit her grandfather's fortune.
descripcion_corta: An English fan translation of a quirky musical adventure.
descripcion_larga: This translation makes the humorous dialogue and song-based "battles" accessible, allowing Western fans to enjoy this unique idol-themed story.

objetivo: Help Erika become a pop star to inherit her grandfather's fortune.
descripcion_corta: A charming adventure game featuring multiple music-themed endings.
descripcion_larga: As Erika, players travel across Japan to find seven talented companions, blending traditional menu-driven exploration with pop-culture humor and catchy 8-bit tunes.

objetivo: Clear the board by matching pairs of Mahjong tiles.
descripcion_corta: An unlicensed "Shisen-sho" style tile-matching puzzle game.
descripcion_larga: Often featuring high-quality idol art as rewards, it challenges the player's pattern recognition skills in a race against the clock.

objetivo: Master the game of Go on a smaller 9x9 grid.
descripcion_corta: A focused version of Go designed for quick play and beginners.
descripcion_larga: By using a smaller board, the game emphasizes the core tactical maneuvers of Go, providing a faster and more intense experience than the full-sized version.

objetivo: Study famous Go matches and solve complex tactical puzzles.
descripcion_corta: A specialized educational title for Go enthusiasts.
descripcion_larga: This game functions as an 8-bit interactive book, allowing players to recreate historical moves and learn from the masters of the game.

objetivo: Improve your Go skills with updated 1991 professional tactics.
descripcion_corta: Part of a long-running series of Go instructional games.
descripcion_larga: It features improved AI and new scenarios based on the professional Go circuit of 1991, offering a serious tool for practice and play.

objetivo: Master the game of Go with refined 1992-era challenges.
descripcion_corta: An updated installment of the popular Go simulation series.
descripcion_larga: Featuring adjusted difficulty levels and more complex endgame scenarios, it continues the series' tradition of high-quality 8-bit board game strategy.

objetivo: Conquer new Go opponents with updated 1993 logic.
descripcion_corta: The third annual update to the Famicom's premier Go series.
descripcion_larga: This version includes a larger library of joseki (standard sequences) and a more aggressive AI, challenging even experienced Go players.

objetivo: Reach the peak of 8-bit Go mastery in this final annual update.
descripcion_corta: The most advanced entry in the Igo Shinan series for Famicom.
descripcion_larga: Representing the technical peak of Go AI on the hardware, it offers the most challenging and complete 8-bit Go experience available.

objetivo: Learn the fundamentals of Go through interactive lessons.
descripcion_corta: The first entry in the long-running Famicom Go instruction series.
descripcion_larga: It established the menu-driven system and AI routines that would make the series a staple for Japanese board game fans on the console.

objetivo: Infiltrate enemy territory as Ralf and Clark to stop a coup.
descripcion_corta: The Japanese version of the legendary SNK arcade port.
descripcion_larga: Known for its intense difficulty and the ability to pilot tanks, it set the standard for military-themed top-down shooters on the Famicom.

objetivo: Battle through mythological realms to defeat the dark gods.
descripcion_corta: The Japanese version of "Victory Road," the second Ikari game.
descripcion_larga: This sequel moves the series into a sci-fi/fantasy setting, where the heroes fight aliens and monsters using futuristic weapons and mystical swords.

objetivo: Infiltrate the enemy base to rescue the kidnapped president's daughter.
descripcion_corta: The third entry, which shifts the focus to hand-to-hand combat.
descripcion_larga: Unlike the first two games, Ikari III focuses more on punching and kicking through waves of enemies, while still maintaining the top-down perspective.

objetivo: Infiltrate the enemy base to rescue the kidnapped president's daughter.
descripcion_corta: The original Japanese release of the third Ikari title.
descripcion_larga: Featuring larger character sprites and more fluid martial arts animations, it offers a distinct "brawler" feel compared to the previous shooting-focused entries.

objetivo: Infiltrate enemy territory as Ralf and Clark to stop a coup.
descripcion_corta: The PAL version of the iconic SNK military shooter.
descripcion_larga: Players must manage limited ammunition and fuel while navigating jungles and enemy bases, fighting through waves of soldiers and armored vehicles.

objetivo: Infiltrate enemy territory as Ralf and Clark to stop a coup.
descripcion_corta: A high-octane 8-bit military shooter famous for its "ABBA" cheat code.
descripcion_larga: Despite some technical slowdown, it captures the arcade's spirit, challenging players to coordinate movement and fire in a brutal jungle warzone.

objetivo: Infiltrate enemy territory with minor technical fixes.
descripcion_corta: A revised version of the first Ikari Warriors for the NES.
descripcion_larga: This revision addresses specific collision bugs and improves some of the sprite-flicker issues present in the initial North American release.

objetivo: Fight through the future to return home and save humanity.
descripcion_corta: The Western release of "Victory Road," featuring a heavy metal vibe.
descripcion_larga: Players explore weird alien worlds, collecting power-ups and using both guns and swords to defeat bizarre extra-terrestrial creatures.

nombre: Ike Ike! Nekketsu Hockey Bu - Subette Koronde Dai Rantou (Japan)
objetivo: Lead Kunio-kun's team to victory in a violent hockey tournament.
descripcion_corta: A legendary comedic hockey game where fighting is encouraged.
descripcion_larga: As part of the Nekketsu series, players can use super-shots, hit opponents with sticks, and engage in chaotic brawls on the ice to win games.

nombre: Ike Ike! Nekketsu Hockey Bu - Subette Koronde Dai Rantou (Japan) [En by Disconnected v0.99] (Technos Ice Hockey)
objetivo: Win the hockey tournament with translated menus and names.
descripcion_corta: An English fan translation that preserves the "Technos" brand feel.
descripcion_larga: This translation makes the team customization and story modes accessible, allowing fans to enjoy Kunio's foray into the world of 8-bit ice hockey.

nombre: Ike Ike! Nekketsu Hockey Bu - Subette Koronde Dai Rantou (Japan) [En by TransBRC v1.1] (Technos Ice Hockey)
objetivo: Win the hockey tournament with a polished English translation.
descripcion_corta: An alternative English version of the Nekketsu Hockey classic.
descripcion_larga: This version focuses on making the dialogue and special move descriptions as clear as possible for a smooth gameplay experience.

objetivo: Compose and play your own digital music on the Famicom.
descripcion_corta: A music creation tool that turns the console into a synthesizer.
descripcion_larga: It allows players to experiment with different waveforms and instruments, featuring a recording mode to save and playback 8-bit compositions.

objetivo: Create digital music in this early development version.
descripcion_corta: A rare prototype of the music creation software.
descripcion_larga: This version offers a look at the early UI and sound engine before the final retail release, sometimes featuring different sample sounds.

objetivo: Lead a peasant rebellion to overthrow a greedy landlord.
descripcion_corta: An early Sunsoft arcade port known for its quirky "peasant" theme.
descripcion_larga: Players throw sickles and collect coins while dodging ninjas and ghosts. It's famous in Japan for being one of the first "Kuso-ge" (lovably bad games).

objetivo: Pass the pilot trials to lead an assault against an alien entity.
descripcion_corta: A challenging Irem shooter with unique "Pod" mechanics.
descripcion_larga: Known for its steep difficulty, players must strategically position orbs (Pods) to shoot in different directions while surviving intense bullet patterns.

objetivo: Pass the pilot trials to lead an assault against an alien entity.
descripcion_corta: A faithful NES port of the tactical Irem arcade shooter.
descripcion_larga: The US version maintains the high difficulty and the iconic "combat training" stages that determine your final mission rank.
